In 2025, the Times Higher Education spiked an article about the allegations against Arday after Arday enlisted the defamation law firm Carter-Ruck to send a letter to the publication. But last month, Nathan Cofnas, a former Fellow at Cambridge, published a post on Substack that blew the Arday story wide open. Using the plagiarism detector Copyleaks, Cofnas found over 30 cases of “substantial overlap” in Arday’s Ph.D. dissertation with the previously-published dissertation of Paula Zwozdiak-Myers , many of them long chunks of verbatim copying, as well as verbatim copying from other sources. Cofnas went through ten other papers of Arday’s, taken from Arday’s own list of “principal and recent publications,” and found significant issues, including plagiarism, in at least four of them. Additional malfeasance included virtually identical quotes attributed to different sources in different papers, which strongly implies that at least some of the quotes from supposed participants in his studies were confabulated .
Meanwhile, Cofnas raised difficult questions about aspects of Arday’s personal story. He noted that running 30 marathons in 35 days would place Arday in the ultra-marathon elite—this without having left any ostensible mark in the running community. “If Arday [did that], I’ll eat my yarmulke,” said Cofnas by telephone. The claim to have raised £5.5 million for charity has already been walked back by Arday, who in a recent interview said the fundraising was done in conjunction with collectives. And Cofnas found that Arday’s two GCSE qualifications—in physical education and textiles—were unobtainable without passing written tests, a detail that challenges the timeline given by Arday that he could not read or write until he was 18. Cofnas also suggests that Arday’s account of his speech development is “medically improbable.”
Cofnas is far from a neutral party in this case. He was fired by Cambridge’s Emmanuel College in 2024 on the back of student protests against him for a Substack post in which he wrote that in a color-blind meritocracy “blacks would disappear from almost all high-profile positions outside of sports and entertainment.” Harris, the academic who first raised questions about Arday’s scholarship, was embroiled in a controversy of his own in which he had his emeritus title at Plymouth Marjon University stripped for a time after he critiqued critical race theory.
How To Fix DEI Rachel Kleinfeld · September 26, 2024 Read full story The fact that his accusers are controversial in their own right may help to explain why so many academics have reflexively defended Arday. In an interview with The Times of London, Arday this week said , “There has been, since I arrived at Cambridge, a very well orchestrated and co-ordinated campaign to unseat me from my position. The motive is racially motivated. I think there’s a reason why it’s me, and I do think that reason is aligned to ableism and racism.” In 2025, when the allegations against Arday were beginning to surface, the Cambridge professors Simon Baron-Cohen and Ricardo Sabates circulated an open letter under the heading “URGENT PLEASE SIGN ANTI-RACISM LETTER FOR JASON ARDAY.” The Good Law Project, an activist organization, orchestrated a solidarity letter last week that has been signed by 14,000 people decrying the “sustained and malicious attacks on the academic integrity of Dr. Jason Arday,” which the letter attributed to “an attempt to undermine Black people who hold positions of influence.” And Cambridge University has wholeheartedly taken Arday’s side. A university spokesperson said , “Professor Arday has been the victim of a vile campaign to undermine his credibility, which must stop.”
So—as you can see—it’s an uncomfortable story landing right on the faultlines of the culture wars. On one side is institutional procedure alongside an institutional culture hyper-sensitive to accusations against what the Good Law Project calls “a working class Black man.” On the other side is the argument that standards must be maintained—and maintained by academic and journalistic vigilantes if the institutions are unwilling to uphold their own meritocratic principles.
And of course the real issue isn’t exactly Arday. It’s the presumption that the politically progressive culture ascendant at Cambridge and in higher education in general has long ago deviated from real meritocracy. By phone, Cofnas was clear on that point. He said, “This is a story about DEI and the corruption that is required to sustain the system of DEI—of elevating people based on identity characteristics rather than merit.”
So what do we do in a case like this, where everybody pretty much sees what they are already predisposed to see? Well, first of all, we look at the source material—and in this case it’s pretty unequivocal. For instance, Arday’s line on page 17 of his 2015 dissertation—“Student teachers are unique individuals and differ in their personal biographies and prior experiences, disposition to enquiry, cognitive and perceptive abilities, communication, interpersonal skills, adaptability, values, and belief systems”—is a perfect match to page 1 of Zwozdiak-Myers’ 2009 dissertation . According to Cofnas, the pattern is repeated dozens of times, while The Telegraph for its part found “more than 100 passages that are identical or nearly identical” to Zwozdiak-Myers’ thesis. There is, as Harris put it , “no other plausible explanation” than plagiarism for the overlaps.
Then, in the week following Cofnas’ Substack post, subsequent reporting found additional patterns of fabulism by Arday. In an open letter to a government minister last year, Arday said he was the victim of innumerable threats and attacks since he took up his Cambridge position. In an interview with The Guardian this week, Arday clarified that he was referring to, among other incidents, a “severed pig’s head” that had been sent to his parents’ London home. That assertion triggered a macabre scavenger hunt, with Guardian journalists visiting the butcher shop that Arday claimed had sold the pig to the assailant. But the butcher said that there had been no police investigation into the incident, as Arday had asserted. For their part, London’s Metropolitan Police said that the details Arday gave of a police investigation into the incident were “categorically” inaccurate.
Arday further claimed that a masked man had accosted him twice at his Cambridge faculty building and threatened him with a knife the second time. But as The Guardian noted, no intruder appeared on CCTV on either occasion, and Arday did not inform colleagues or interrupt his working day after the alleged knife incident.
Meanwhile, a recently-surfaced video interview with Arday appears to show him claiming that he starred in the acclaimed documentary “Seven Up”—a mathematical impossibility unless Arday was actually born in 1956. And just today Glasgow University has denied Arday’s claim that he held a visiting professorship there.
Given all that—the all-but-indisputable evidence of plagiarism, in addition to the patterns of fanciful statements by Arday—the case for his defense collapses. “I think it’s plagiarism and it’s obvious,” one academic told The Guardian under condition of anonymity. “There is no question that there is extensive plagiarism,” David Sanders, an independent researcher who reviewed Arday’s case last year for Times Higher Education , said to Retraction Watch.
What Being a Digital Nomad Taught Me About the Real World Sam Kahn · Jul 27 Read full story Arday, for his part, did not, in a wide-ranging interview he gave to The Times of London last week, directly challenge the primary allegation of plagiarism and academic misconduct. He said, “I am accountable for the mistakes I’ve made. I hold myself accountable and other people should hold me accountable.” Instead, he took another line of defense, contending, “We’re talking about academia here. I didn’t murder somebody. I think the cruelty that I’ve experienced and the positioning of me as this kind of liar and fantasist is totally unacceptable.”
If it’s fair to say that the preponderance of evidence at this point speaks to serious academic misconduct on Arday’s part, the next question—picking up on Arday’s lead—is to ask ourselves what the stakes are here and what the story is really about. Arday is right of course that one academic with a shaky relationship to the truth is not, by itself, a huge deal. But, unfortunately for Arday’s defense, it is a story with more reach than he admits and it really does indict the institutions backing him.
For one thing, there is the issue of how Arday and his supporters have tried to defend him. There has been very little of the accountability Arday has called for—and there has been no willingness to look at the very obvious evidence of academic misconduct. The overriding tendency has been to shoot the messenger and to go after the academics, particularly Harris and Cofnas, who called attention to the issues in Arday’s work. According to The Guardian, Arday attempted to lodge a police complaint against Harris. Earlier this year, he dedicated a talk at the British Sociological Association to the “playbook” employed by conservative activists to target black professors. “There isn’t any room to sit there and watch your fellows suffer for no reason. It’s abhorrent, it’s a disgrace and, quite frankly, evil,” Arday said .
Apart from the often vitriolic counter-attack against Arday’s accusers, there has been a tendency to dodge the issue and shield Arday through arguments related to his neurodivergence. “1 in 4 autistic people have planned or attempted suicide. That’s why I’m very concerned about the impa

The University of Cambridge ought to proceed with its probe into how Professor Jason Arday was recruited and his period teaching at the institution, according to a friend and former colleague.
Prof Arday, who was found dead on Friday, stepped down from his post as professor of sociology of education last week following allegations of plagiarism made against him.
Prior to his death, the university stated that it would look into the circumstances surrounding his "appointment and tenure", with the conclusions feeding into a wider review of senior recruitment processes.
It is understood that the university currently feels it would not be right to decide whether to continue the inquiry while Prof Arday’s family is grieving.
Sir Simon Baron-Cohen, a friend and former colleague of Prof Arday, told Times Radio that the university should "always be reflecting on how it’s operating and whether it can do better".
The Cambridge professor and director of the Autism Research Centre said: “They have announced an investigation, and we should let that proceed.
“We should we should see what we learn from it. This is the whole purpose of investigations.
“When you’re talking about what’s in the public interest, when you’ve got public bodies like universities or, arguably, the media, political institutions, whatever, when we have investigations, it’s all about how can we improve them.”
Sir Simon said the professor’s mental health had been left “in tatters”, adding there were questions about whether the media failed in its duty of care towards him as a vulnerable person with disabilities.
He said the professor faced racist abuse and was used as a “lightning rod for a culture war on DEI (diversity, equity and inclusion)”.
“(Prof Arday) started reporting racism within weeks of him being at Cambridge,” Sir Simon said.
“It included things like threats of physical assault to himself and his family, racist hate speech, and racist actions, hate actions.”
Lord Simon Woolley, principal of Homerton College, Cambridge, and a former mentor of Prof Arday, told BBC Radio 4’s Broadcasting House programme that his friend felt “hounded to death”.
Lord Woolley said: “In a conversation I had with Jason on the Monday – we met on Monday, with a few dear friends – he said he felt hounded to death, his words, that he couldn’t see a way out.”
He added: “On that day, we saw a man half his body weight and desperate beyond belief.”
The crossbench peer said Prof Arday had been subjected to “the most horrendous, toxic, vicious witch hunt”, and called for an investigation into the “vicious media onslaught”.
“The whole of the black community and black academics have been brought into this debate as though we don’t belong in these positions, because we are collectively the diversity, equity and inclusion hires,” Lord Woolley added.
A fundraiser for Prof Arday’s family, set up by Windrush campaigner Sir Patrick Vernon, has raised more than £60,000.
The organisation Stand Up To Racism has announced plans for a vigil for Prof Arday to be held on the steps of the National Gallery in Trafalgar Square, central London, at 6pm on Monday.
On Saturday, Prime Minister Andy Burnham described the professor’s death as a “tragedy on so many levels”, adding: “It’s not a moment for any rushing to judgment. It’s a moment for reflection, I would say, reflecting on how things came to this.”
In a statement issued by his publisher Simon & Schuster UK on Friday, Prof Arday’s family said he had been subjected to a “campaign of sustained abuse” since he accepted the role of professor at Cambridge.
They said: “The campaign of misinformation was too much for Jason, who was a gentle man and who always wanted to see the best in everyone.”

topic_zh: 对Jason Arday的同情与理解
claim_zh: Jason Arday在面对媒体的持续压力和职业生涯的丧失时，感到无法承受，缺乏必要的支持。
evidence_zh: 他被持续的审视和嘲笑所困扰，失去了职业和声誉。
article_body:
Coffee House Melanie McDonagh The tragedy of Jason Arday Saturday, August 15, 2026, 10:30 AM Jason Arday (Credit: BBC) Text settings Text size Small Medium Large Line Spacing Compact Normal Spacious Comments Share Share Melanie McDonagh
Copied Linkedin Messenger Email Simon Baron-Cohen, the distinguished Cambridge autism specialist, has been speaking movingly about his friend, Jason Arday, in a BBC radio interview. Baron-Cohen said the last contact he had with Arday was hours before he was found dead at an address in south London yesterday afternoon: “He really wasn’t coping. He was being subjected to relentless scrutiny… ridicule, discrediting every detail of his life… He wasn’t coping with the loss of his career, the loss of his reputation. He felt he couldn’t go on.”
Jason Arday was a victim, but not in the way that his political champions suggest
Baron-Cohen went on to talk about him as “an incredibly kind and gentle and caring and generous man”. From his own perspective, he observed, “at the heart of all this was a man who was diagnosed with autism and language differences…he needed support every step of the way… after the allegations of plagiarism, [the] media didn’t leave him alone.”
It is good to be reminded of Jason Arday as a friend, by a friend. For in death we all should be remembered in our humanity, even in our flawed humanity. And Jason Arday was very human; he bled. He was not just a totem of DEI (Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion), but as the Prof said, a vulnerable man. It’s sometimes hard for pundits, self included, to remember how terrifying it is to be at the heart of a media firestorm. Jason Arday isn’t the first to feel the pressure to be unbearable. We may not feel exactly guilt at participating in the row, but it would be strange if we didn’t feel sober, chastened, by his tragic end.
De mortuis nil nisi bonum is a good motto, but in Arday’s case, the difficulty about speaking no evil of the dead is in disentangling the man, the human being, from the issue. And the issue was quite legitimate: the apparent dearth of scrutiny of his successive appointments, the uncritical and unquestioned acceptance of his work and his claims as, for instance, a fundraiser. His family, in their pain, has talked about him as the victim of misinformation. This isn’t, I would say, the whole case, though this isn’t the time to rehearse the details.
Before his death becomes weaponized – as it already risks being – in the culture wars, we should make one thing clear, as I, in fact, did before he died. It is that the problem was not Jason Arday; it was with the individuals who lionized him, who promoted him beyond his capacities, who raised him up prematurely to stellar heights at an age which would have been remarkable for anyone, regardless of ethnicity. It is the individuals behind the system which created Jason Arday, the poster image of DEI, who should be asking themselves some questions.
Arday can hardly be blamed for not resisting this inexorable trajectory. And, I would say, the fault is with Cambridge for making a dud subject like Education a faculty on the same level as history or natural sciences or classics. Jason Arday was a victim, but not quite in the way that his political champions suggest.
He was also a man, a father, a son, a brother and an uncle, as his family have said, and it is as such he is being mourned. Requiescat in pace.
Melanie McDonagh is an Irish journalist working in London.

title_zh: 杰森·阿尔代的悲剧
summary_zh: 本文讨论了杰森·阿尔代在面对媒体持续压力和职业生涯丧失时的困境。阿尔代被诊断为自闭症（autism）和语言障碍（language differences），在经历抄袭指控后，他感到无法承受来自媒体的无情审视和嘲笑，缺乏必要的支持。他失去了职业和声誉，内心深处感到绝望，认为自己无法继续前行。文章强调了在这种情况下，社会对有特殊需求人士的支持和理解的重要性。
l1_lead: 杰森·阿尔代因媒体压力和职业危机感到绝望，突显了社会对特殊需求人士支持与理解的重要性。
l2_summary:
杰森·阿尔代的悲剧揭示了在媒体压力和职业生涯丧失的双重打击下，特殊需求人士所面临的困境。阿尔代被诊断为自闭症（autism）和语言障碍（language differences），这使他在面对外界的审视时显得更加脆弱。在经历了抄袭指控后，媒体的持续关注和无情的嘲笑让他感到无所适从，缺乏必要的支持与理解。他的职业生涯因此受到重创，声誉也随之崩塌，内心深处的绝望感愈发加重，令他认为自己无法继续前行。

文章强调了社会对有特殊需求人士的支持和理解的重要性，指出在面对困境时，缺乏适当的帮助和关怀可能会导致更严重的心理和情感问题。阿尔代的经历不仅是个人的悲剧，更是对社会如何对待特殊需求人士的深刻反思。通过他的故事，读者能够感受到在职业生涯和个人生活中，理解与支持的重要性，以及在面对困难时，社会应当提供怎样的帮助。杰森·阿尔代的遭遇提醒我们，只有通过建立一个更具包容性和理解的环境，才能真正帮助那些在逆境中挣扎的人们。

Two weeks ago, following a conversation with Jason Arday, Professor Simon Baron-Cohen posted a message on X.
The psychologist said he was “very concerned” about the impact of media coverage on his friend, who had autism, and linked it to work his Autism Research Centre at Cambridge University had done showing that autistic people were at a greater risk of suicide.
“This is relentless bullying of a vulnerable autistic man and raises safe-guarding issues,” he wrote. “It’s time to stop.” The site’s owner, Elon Musk, responded to the post with one word: “Liar”.
Yesterday, Baron-Cohen said Arday had sent him a voice note via WhatsApp on the morning of his death. “He was being subjected to relentless scrutiny, including ridicule, discrediting absolutely every detail of his life, and he wasn’t coping with… he felt he couldn’t go on,” he told Radio 4’s Today programme.
In 2022, Baron-Cohen and psychologists from other UK universities found that autistic people had an elevated risk of suicide. They examined 372 coroners’ inquest reports over a three-year period to find out whether the person who died had been diagnosed with autism or had autistic traits. They found evidence of autism in more than 10% of those who died, compared with about 1.1% of the population overall.
Jill Aylott, founder of the National Autism and ADHD Assessment Centre, said: “accountability should never require us to abandon humanity.
“When somebody becomes the focus of sustained national criticism, particularly where that person is known to be neurodivergent, institutions should be asking: who is checking that this person is safe?”
Baron-Cohen said that for the last 10 days he had seen Arday’s mental health “getting worse and worse”.

Photograph: Christian Sinibaldi/The Guardian Jason Arday This article is more than 1 month old Tributes paid to Jason Arday after former Cambridge professor’s death This article is more than 1 month old Andy Burnham calls for reflection after ‘tragedy on so many levels’ in comments echoed by London mayor Sadiq Khan
Prefer the Guardian on Google Andy Burnham has called the death of Jason Arday , whose body was found at his home in south London on Friday, a “tragedy on so many levels”.
Arday resigned as a professor at the University of Cambridge last week after allegations of plagiarism, which he denied. He was pronounced dead just after 3pm on Friday .
In a statement issued via his publisher, Simon & Schuster UK, the former academic’s family said they were “in shock to have lost this amazing father, partner, brother, uncle and son”.
Speaking to broadcasters during a visit to Cornwall on Saturday, the prime minister said: “It’s a tragedy on so many levels, but particularly just for everybody who knew Jason, his family obviously, his friends. We think of them today.
“It’s not a moment for any rushing to judgment. It’s a moment for reflection, I would say, reflecting on how things came to this. A really sad, sad and sorry state of affairs and I think we all today think of Jason, his contribution and his family and friends.”
More than £20,000 has been raised for the family of Arday after the Windrush campaigner Sir Patrick Vernon launched a fundraising drive via GoFundMe in his memory.
Other leading figures to pay tribute included the London mayor, Sadiq Khan, and the Labour MP Bell Ribeiro-Addy.
Khan said: “I’m devastated for the family and friends of Jason Arday. He faced an unacceptable public hounding and campaign of abuse. I know many Londoners will be angry and upset this evening.
“Jason Arday was the victim of a pernicious public shaming that other people in his position simply wouldn’t have faced. His death was a tragedy, but once again it should be a wake-up call for all of us.”
Speaking on Newsnight, Ribeiro-Addy read out a list of names including William O’Reilly, Ros Holmes, David Latchman, and Nicola Morrison. “These are all people that have actually proven to have been plagiarists, or people that have manipulated their data, and people that have been proven to have lifted whole pages from students’ papers or published work that they had to withdraw,” she said.
Ribeiro-Addy said there had been a media witch-hunt which was cruel because “it didn’t aim to just target him”.
“It aimed to target anybody that supported him, trying to isolate him as much as possible, going after people who had signed up to statements,” she said. “The difference between them and him was they were white, and he was not.”
The Conservative MP James Cleverly expressed his anger over Arday’s death. In a statement on X, he wrote that a number of people at academic institutions “have serious questions to answer”.
“They put him into positions he was clearly not qualified for so they could have a black wunderkind to show off, they pushed him into the spotlight for their own benefit,” they said. “His exposure was inevitable, a case of when, not if. His whole world fell apart.”
Simon Baron-Cohen, a clinical psychologist and the director of the Autism Research Centre, who was a friend of Arday’s, told Radio 4’s Today programme that he contacted him Friday morning and said that he felt he was unable to go on.
“He used those words in voice notes,” Baron-Cohen said. “At the heart of all of this was a man who’d been diagnosed in childhood with disabilities that included autism and language delay and learning differences.
“He was a vulnerable child, a vulnerable teenager and a vulnerable adult, so he needed and deserved safeguarding and support and reasonable adjustment every step of the way.”

Our morning email breaks down the key stories of the day, telling you what’s happening and why it matters
Arday was initially accused of plagiarising another person’s work in his PhD thesis, but denied all allegations. A review conducted by Liverpool John Moores University, where he completed his doctorate, upheld its decision to award him a PhD earlier this year.
In recent weeks, other elements of his life story were increasingly questioned , including claims of prodigious money-raising for charity and feats of long-distance running. He was also challenged about whether he was nonverbal as a child.
The National Education Union general secretary, Daniel Kebede, said Arday had been subjected to “a public and brutal takedown that unleashed a tirade of racism”.
“I don’t believe this was ever simply about ‘professional conduct’ or ‘plagiarism’,” he said.
“There is a profound difference between scrutiny and a sustained public campaign that turns an individual into a symbol of everything the right believes is wrong with DEI.
“The effect has been chilling. It tells Black people and others from underrepresented backgrounds that entering prominent public positions will make you a target.
“A target not only for criticism of your work, but for a much broader political and cultural backlash.”
The Metropolitan police said his death was being treated as unexpected, but not believed to be suspicious.
In the UK and Ireland, Samaritans can be contacted on freephone 116 123. In the US, you can call or text the 988 Suicide & Crisis Lifeline at 988 or chat at 988lifeline.org . In Australia, the crisis support service Lifeline is 13 11 14. Other international helplines can be found at befrienders.org
This article was amended on 16 August 2026 to correct the spelling of the names of Ros Holmes and David Latchman.
title_zh: 阿尔代：脆弱个体的保护与支持
summary_zh: 文章讨论了已故剑桥大学教授阿尔代的成长经历，强调他在童年时期被诊断出自闭症、语言延迟和学习差异等障碍。作者指出，阿尔代作为一个脆弱的孩子、青少年和成年人，始终需要并应当得到保护、支持和合理的调整。文章的核心论点是，社会应为像阿尔代这样的脆弱个体提供必要的保障，以确保他们在成长过程中能够获得平等的机会和支持。
l1_lead: 社会应为脆弱个体提供必要的保护与支持，以确保他们在成长过程中获得平等的机会和合理的调整。
l2_summary:
阿尔代（Alday）是已故剑桥大学教授，他的成长经历为我们提供了对脆弱个体保护与支持的重要思考。文章指出，阿尔代在童年时期被诊断出自闭症（Autism）、语言延迟（Language Delay）和学习差异（Learning Differences），这些障碍使他在生活的各个阶段都面临着挑战。作为一个脆弱的孩子、青少年和成年人，阿尔代始终需要保护和支持，这不仅是他个人的需求，也是社会应承担的责任。

文章的核心论点强调，社会应为像阿尔代这样的脆弱个体提供必要的保障，以确保他们在成长过程中能够获得平等的机会和支持。阿尔代的经历表明，缺乏适当的支持和合理的调整，脆弱个体可能会面临更大的困难和孤立。因此，社会各界应当关注这些个体的需求，提供必要的资源和环境，以帮助他们克服障碍，实现自我价值。

通过对阿尔代的成长故事的分析，作者呼吁社会重视脆弱个体的权益，倡导建立一个包容的环境，使每一个人都能在平等的基础上获得发展机会。这样的支持不仅有助于脆弱个体的成长，也将促进整个社会的和谐与进步。总之，阿尔代的经历提醒我们，保护和支持脆弱个体是社会的共同责任，只有通过集体的努力，才能为他们创造一个更加友好的生活和学习环境。

title: Warnings about Jason Arday’s mental health were ignored by the press - Good Law Project
body:
原话：“I’m very concerned about the impact of the media coverage on Jason Arday who is autistic.”
论点：媒体对自闭症人士Jason Arday的报道可能产生负面影响。
authors: Simon Baron‐Cohen
attribution_basis: Google News 全名命中 + LLM 同一人核验（Good Law Project） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: I’m very concerned about the impact of the media coverage on Jason Arday who is autistic.
topic_zh: 媒体报道对自闭症人士的影响
claim_zh: 媒体对自闭症人士Jason Arday的报道可能产生负面影响。
article_body:
We use cookies where necessary to allow us to understand how people interact with our website and content, so that we can continue to improve our service.
Dr Arday’s death was the direct result of media harassment – we’re demanding a public inquiry to prevent this from ever happening again
Before his death on Friday, Dr Jason Arday was subject to a barrage of racist, ableist and cruel media attention, which continued to escalate even after his resignation on August 5th.
The press attention was unrelenting. 249 articles were published in 22 days, mostly led by the broadsheets. This wasn’t a tabloid scandal – the journalists involved were often public figures in their own right.
A resignation normally causes the media to back off, but they only produced more content. Stories about Jason were driving clicks – with outlets like The Times even putting out paid adverts for their articles .
In his resignation letter, Dr Jason Arday said to his supporters “you have carried me through some of the darkest moments of my life”; “I need time to heal”; “space to begin again” and that he had “reached the limits of what any person should reasonably be expected to endure.”
Jason wasn’t the only one asking the press to stop.
Professor Simon Baron Cohen released a statement on July 31st, leaning on his expertise in autism, stating:
“I’m very concerned about the impact of the media coverage on Professor Jason Arday who is autistic.
He has been accused of plagiarism and he was cleared of any academic misconduct following a rigorous investigation by Liverpool John Moores University.
And yet he continues to be systematically discredited over every detail of his life, daily. We should of course always investigate plagiarism to protect academic standards.
However, I cannot stand by and watch when an autistic man is on the ground and the kicking continues. This is relentless bullying of a vulnerable autistic man and raises safe-guarding issues. It’s time to stop.”
The day afterwards, the Guardian published an article titled “Playbooks, plagiarism and a pig’s head: new claims surrounding a star Cambridge professor”.
Before this article was published, details of it were sent to Jason to give him an opportunity to respond. His supporters contacted The Guardian about this piece. A letter was sent to Katharine Viner, the Editor-in-Chief of the Guardian, and separate contact was made with the journalist writing the piece.
This article dissected Jason’s claims about his personal life, and the Guardian featured it on their podcast, Today In Focus. A reel the Guardian posted of that podcast, where the claims within the article were played for laughs, has since been deleted.
The Guardian’s coverage continued after Arday’s resignation, interviewing people who knew Jason as a child to question whether he was really non-verbal. The intense focus on Jason’s background and disability was widespread, with The Daily Mail even carrying a piece from a psychiatrist pondering a diagnosis for Jason, tempered only by the context that “I should say that I’ve never met Jason Arday, and so have no idea what has been going on in his mind, or how much truth there may or may not be in his life story.”
During the escalating coverage, those who supported Arday received countless requests for interviews and quotes.
These journalists were often warned about Jason’s wellbeing, and were still not dissuaded from chasing the story.
The writer and broadcaster Nels Abbey and Lord Simon Woolley , the Principal of Homerton College, both expressed their concerns.
Nels shared an example of this type of correspondence from the 3rd of August with a journalist during the firestorm, explicitly making clear his concern for Jason’s wellbeing.
Despite warnings from those around Jason trying to safeguard him from the onslaught, the stories kept coming.
Hours after Jason died, The Times ran a (now deleted) story headlined “Jason Arday may want to get himself a nice pair of orange trousers”.
Whilst this continued, the racist and eugenist academic Nathan Cofnas, who instigated the story, gave a little remarked upon interview to a right-wing youtuber, joking: “ After the revolution, I’ll be the head of the dept of eugenics & race science at Harvard.”
We believe that the press must be held accountable for their racist, profit-motivated conduct that led to Jason’s death. We’re calling for a public inquiry into how to ensure a responsible press given its contribution to Dr Arday’s tragic death.

title_zh: 媒体忽视Jason Arday心理健康警告的影响
summary_zh: 本文讨论了媒体对自闭症人士Jason Arday的报道可能带来的负面影响。文章引用了对Arday心理健康的担忧，指出媒体在报道中未能充分考虑其自闭症（autism）背景，可能加剧了对其的误解和偏见。专家强调，媒体的关注应更加谨慎，以避免对Arday及其他自闭症人士造成伤害。整体而言，文章呼吁媒体在报道此类敏感话题时，需更加关注受影响者的心理健康和社会影响。
l1_lead: 媒体在报道自闭症人士Jason Arday时忽视其心理健康背景，可能加剧误解与偏见，呼吁更谨慎的报道以保护受影响者。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了媒体对自闭症人士Jason Arday的报道可能带来的负面影响，特别是对其心理健康的潜在威胁。文章指出，媒体在报道中未能充分考虑Arday的自闭症背景，导致对他的误解和偏见加剧。专家们强调，媒体在关注此类敏感话题时，应更加谨慎，以避免对Arday及其他自闭症人士造成进一步的伤害。报道中提到的心理健康担忧，反映了社会对自闭症人士的普遍误解，这种误解不仅影响了公众对他们的看法，也可能对他们的心理健康产生负面影响。

整体而言，文章呼吁媒体在报道涉及自闭症及相关心理健康问题时，需更加关注受影响者的心理健康和社会影响。通过对Arday案例的分析，作者希望引起媒体和公众对自闭症人士心理健康问题的重视，促使媒体在报道时采取更为负责任的态度，以减少对自闭症人士的偏见和误解。

title: Appraisal of Gene Expression-Based Classifiers for Neuropsychiatric Disorders: A Meta-Regression.
body: A substantial body of research examines the potential of gene-expression-based biomarkers for diagnosing and selecting treatments for neuropsychiatric disorders, yet no clear consensus has been reached regarding the influence of controllable factors such as study design and model selection on the performance of gene-expression-based classifiers. To investigate study characteristics and methodologies that influence the accuracy of studies using transcriptomics to classify neuropsychiatric disorders, we conducted a literature review and meta-regression of relevant studies. We extracted several characteristics from each study, including the number of samples in a training dataset, approach for model validation, and classification model. Using univariate and multivariate mixed-effect meta-regression analyses, we estimated the association between these study characteristics and reported classification accuracies. Machine Learning (ML) models accounted for 55% of all models; Deep Learning (DL) models accounted for 20%, and variations of Logistic Regression models made up the remaining 25%. Support vector machine (SVM) was the most common model type (17%). The use of withheld test samples (56%) was the most frequent approach for validating the performance of classification models. We found significant associations between reported accuracies and study-rated bias risk, model type, class ratio, and validation approach. Overall, this review provides helpful insights into study characteristics that significantly influence classification accuracies and emphasizes the importance of prudent methodologies for training and evaluating classification models to mitigate biased accuracy estimates. In future research, these findings can direct study designs and support the development of clinically reliable, minimally invasive gene-expression biomarkers to improve diagnostic workflows and patient outcomes in neuropsychiatry.
journal: American journal of medical genetics. Part B, Neuropsychiatric genetics : the official publication of the International Society of Psychiatric Genetics
authors: Razavi A, Arensman B, Barnett EJ, Lee LA, Faraone SV, Glatt SJ, Hess JL.
title_zh: 基于基因表达的神经精神疾病分类器评估：元回归分析
summary_zh: 本文评估了基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断和治疗选择中的潜力，探讨了研究设计和模型选择等可控因素对基因表达分类器性能的影响。通过文献回顾和元回归分析，我们提取了相关研究的多个特征，包括训练数据集样本数量、模型验证方法和分类模型类型。结果显示，机器学习（ML）模型占所有模型的55%，深度学习（DL）模型占20%，逻辑回归模型变种占25%。支持向量机（SVM）是最常见的模型类型（17%）。使用保留测试样本（56%）是验证分类模型性能的最常用方法。研究发现，报告的分类准确性与研究评估的偏倚风险、模型类型等因素之间存在显著关联。
l1_lead: 基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断中的应用潜力受到研究设计和模型选择等因素的显著影响，机器学习和深度学习模型表现突出。
l2_summary:
本文对基因表达生物标志物在神经精神疾病诊断和治疗选择中的应用潜力进行了评估，重点探讨了研究设计和模型选择等可控因素对基因表达分类器性能的影响。通过文献回顾和元回归分析，研究提取了多个相关特征，包括训练数据集样本数量、模型验证方法和分类模型类型。结果显示，机器学习（ML）模型在所有模型中占比55%，深度学习（DL）模型占20%，而逻辑回归模型的变种占25%。在不同模型类型中，支持向量机（SVM）是最常见的，使用比例为17%。在模型验证方法方面，使用保留测试样本的比例高达56%，成为验证分类模型性能的最常用方法。

研究还发现，报告的分类准确性与研究评估的偏倚风险、模型类型等因素之间存在显著关联。这表明，研究设计的严谨性和模型选择的合理性对基因表达分类器的性能具有重要影响。因此，未来在神经精神疾病的研究中，需更加关注这些可控因素，以提高基因表达生物标志物的诊断和治疗选择的有效性。整体而言，本文为基因表达在神经精神疾病领域的应用提供了重要的实证支持，并为后续研究指明了方向。

title: Prevalence of attention deficit hyperactivity disorder/hyperkinetic disorder of pediatric and adult populations in clinical settings: a systematic review, meta-analysis and meta-regression.
body: Background Attention-Deficit/Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)/Hyperkinetic Disorder (HD) is linked to increased risks of morbidity, comorbidity and mortality, with higher prevalence in clinical populations. The differential prevalence of ADHD/HD across adult and pediatric clinical populations, influenced by factors such as time trends, sex, age, geographic regions, and comorbidities, has not been systematically assessed. Methods MEDLINE, CINAHL, Embase and PsycINFO databases were searched from inception to 1st August 2023 for eligible full-text papers published in English, and reviewing reference lists of identified studies and review papers. Studies reporting ADHD/HD prevalence in adult and pediatric clinical populations were included. Meta-regression evaluated the effects of geographic region, year of publication and sample size. Results From 30,740 citations, we reviewed 521 full-text articles, yielding 311 studies for inclusion (including 653,558 pediatric and 43,311 adult participants). Overall, worldwide pooled prevalence of ADHD/HD in clinical settings for pediatrics was 32.4% (95% CI 31-34%), and in adults 21.4% (95% CI 20-23%). Prevalence was higher in outpatient settings than inpatient settings. Prevalence based on rating scales was higher than studies using diagnostic interviews or clinical record review. Prevalence varied significantly across subspecialist settings for children and adults. No significant time trend was detected between 1981-2023. Pediatric prevalence appears influenced by geographic region but not year of publication or sample size. For adults, larger sample sizes were associated with lower prevalence estimates. Conclusions ADHD/HD prevalence in clinical populations is 8-9-fold higher than community estimates. With these patients at risk for many adverse outcomes, our findings underscore the critical importance of resource allocation for screening, diagnosing and treatment.
authors: Johnson S, Lim E, Jacoby P, Faraone SV, Su BM, Solmi M, Forrest B, Furfaro B, von Klier K, Downs J, Chen W.
title_zh: 临床人群中注意缺陷多动障碍的流行病学研究综述
summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）/多动障碍（HD）在儿童和成人临床人群中的流行情况。通过检索MEDLINE、CINAHL、Embase和PsycINFO数据库，纳入了311项研究，涉及653,558名儿童和43,311名成人参与者。结果显示，全球儿童临床环境中ADHD/HD的合并流行率为32.4%（95% CI 31-34%），成人为21.4%（95% CI 20-23%）。门诊环境中的流行率高于住院环境，基于评定量表的流行率高于使用诊断访谈或临床记录审查的研究。流行率在不同的专科设置中显著不同。
l1_lead: 本研究显示，全球儿童和成人临床人群中注意缺陷多动障碍的合并流行率分别为32.4%和21.4%，且门诊环境中的流行率高于住院环境。
l2_summary: 本研究系统评估了注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD，Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder）和多动障碍（HD，Hyperactivity Disorder）在儿童和成人临床人群中的流行情况。研究通过检索MEDLINE、CINAHL、Embase和PsycINFO数据库，纳入了311项研究，涉及653,558名儿童和43,311名成人参与者。结果显示，全球儿童临床环境中ADHD/HD的合并流行率为32.4%（95% CI 31-34%），而成人的流行率为21.4%（95% CI 20-23%）。研究还发现，门诊环境中的流行率普遍高于住院环境，且基于评定量表的流行率高于使用诊断访谈或临床记录审查的研究。此外，流行率在不同专科设置中存在显著差异。这些数据表明，ADHD/HD在临床人群中具有较高的流行率，尤其是在儿童中，提示了对该障碍的关注和干预的必要性。研究结果为临床实践和公共卫生政策提供了重要的参考依据。

title: Role of serotonin in psychiatric and somatic comorbidities of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder: a systematic literature review.
body: Introduction Serotonin is a well-established modulator of various neuropsychological processes, as well as organ and endocrine functioning, and metabolism and homeostasis. Serotonin has been implicated in the neurobiology of attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD). Herein, the evidence for a serotonergic link between psychiatric and somatic comorbidities associated with ADHD was evaluated. Methods A systematic literature review was conducted of the published literature to identify comorbidities proven to co-occur with ADHD and determine whether there was any serotonergic pathophysiology associated with these comorbidities. The average grade of serotonergic evidence was calculated and plotted alongside the volume of publications for each identified comorbidity. The date of the last search was 7 March 2024. Results One hundred eighty-two individual comorbidities commonly occurring in ADHD populations were identified; 135 (74.2 %) had evidence for serotonergic pathophysiology, including 91 psychiatric and 44 somatic conditions. The grade of evidence for a serotonergic role in the pathophysiology of a given comorbidity was generally medium to high or high. Conclusions Findings indicate that serotonin plays a key role, alongside dopamine and norepinephrine, in ADHD neurobiology. Serotonin involvement in physiological functioning suggests that dysregulation is likely to generate a broad spectrum of clinical manifestations, which may account for the unique presentation of neuropsychiatric behaviors and comorbidities found in patients with ADHD.
authors: Faraone SV, Ward CL, Boucher M, Elbekai R, Brunner E.
title_zh: 血清素在注意缺陷多动障碍合并症中的作用综述
summary_zh: 本文系统评述了血清素在注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）相关精神和躯体合并症中的作用。研究通过文献回顾，识别出182种与ADHD人群常见的合并症，其中135种（74.2%）显示出与血清素（serotonin）相关的病理生理证据，包括91种精神疾病和44种躯体疾病。对每种合并症的血清素作用证据等级普遍为中等至高或高。研究结果表明，血清素在ADHD的神经生物学中与多巴胺和去甲肾上腺素共同发挥关键作用，且血清素在生理功能中的参与暗示其失调可能导致相关合并症的发生。
l1_lead: 血清素在注意缺陷多动障碍及其合并症中发挥关键作用，其失调可能导致多种精神和躯体疾病的发生。
l2_summary:
本文系统评述了血清素（serotonin）在注意缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）相关精神和躯体合并症中的作用。通过对相关文献的回顾，研究识别出182种与ADHD人群常见的合并症，其中有135种（占74.2%）显示出与血清素相关的病理生理证据。这些合并症中包括91种精神疾病和44种躯体疾病，表明血清素在ADHD的合并症中扮演着重要角色。对每种合并症的血清素作用证据的评估结果普遍为中等至高或高，进一步支持了血清素在ADHD相关合并症中的关键作用。

研究结果表明，血清素与多巴胺（dopamine）和去甲肾上腺素（norepinephrine）共同参与ADHD的神经生物学过程。血清素在生理功能中的参与暗示其失调可能导致相关合并症的发生。这一发现为理解ADHD及其合并症的病理机制提供了新的视角，也为未来的治疗策略提供了潜在的靶点。因此，血清素不仅在ADHD的发病机制中占据重要地位，也可能在其相关合并症的预防和治疗中发挥关键作用。

title: Yes, ADHD diagnoses are rising, but that doesn’t mean it’s overdiagnosed
body: ADHD symptoms occur on a continuum and can fluctuate dramatically based on life circumstances such as transitions to middle school, stress levels and even sleep.
authors: Stephen V. Faraone

title_zh: ADHD诊断上升，但并不意味着过度诊断
summary_zh: 本文讨论了注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的诊断上升现象，指出ADHD症状存在连续性，并且会因生活环境的变化而显著波动，例如中学过渡、压力水平和睡眠质量等因素。文章强调，尽管ADHD的诊断数量在增加，但这并不意味着该疾病被过度诊断。相反，症状的多样性和个体差异使得准确诊断变得复杂，需考虑多种影响因素。
l1_lead: ADHD诊断上升反映了症状的多样性和个体差异，并不意味着过度诊断，而是需综合考虑生活环境等多种影响因素。
l2_summary:
近年来，注意力缺陷多动障碍（ADHD）的诊断数量显著上升，引发了广泛的讨论和关注。本文探讨了这一现象，指出ADHD症状的存在具有连续性，并且会受到多种生活环境因素的显著影响，例如中学过渡、压力水平和睡眠质量等。这些因素不仅影响个体的行为表现，也可能导致ADHD症状的波动。因此，尽管ADHD的诊断数量在不断增加，但这并不意味着该疾病被过度诊断。

文章强调，ADHD的症状表现多样且个体差异显著，使得准确诊断变得复杂。不同个体在不同环境下可能表现出不同的症状，且这些症状的严重程度也会因生活阶段和心理状态的变化而有所不同。这种复杂性要求在诊断时考虑多种影响因素，而不仅仅是依赖于单一的标准或指标。

此外，随着对ADHD认识的加深，社会对该疾病的关注度也在提升，这可能导致更多的个体寻求专业帮助，从而增加了诊断的数量。然而，这种现象并不意味着过度诊断，而是反映了对ADHD理解的深化和对症状识别的敏感性提高。因此，尽管ADHD的诊断在上升，仍需谨慎对待，确保每个个体都能获得准确的评估和适当的支持。总之，ADHD的诊断上升是一个复杂的现象，涉及多方面的因素，而非简单的过度诊断问题。
l3_translation:
许多新闻媒体报道了注意缺陷/多动障碍（ADHD）在儿童和成人中的诊断数量增加或激增。同时，医疗保健提供者、教师和学校系统也报告了对ADHD评估请求的上升。

这些报告使一些专家和家长开始怀疑ADHD是否被过度诊断和过度治疗。

作为研究神经发育障碍（如ADHD）多年的研究人员，我们担心对广泛过度诊断的恐惧是错误的，可能是基于对这种疾病的根本误解。

关于ADHD过度诊断的讨论暗示你要么有这种病，要么没有。

然而，当流行病学家询问普通人群中人们的ADHD症状时，有些人有一些症状，有些人有中等程度的症状，还有一些人有很多症状。但在被诊断为ADHD的人和未被诊断的人之间并没有明确的分界线，因为ADHD——就像血压一样——是一个光谱上的现象。

治疗轻度ADHD类似于治疗轻度高血压——这取决于具体情况。当医生考虑到一个人的日常生活细节以及症状对他们的影响时，治疗可能会有所帮助。

ADHD症状不仅因人而异，研究还表明ADHD症状在个体内也可能发生变化。例如，当生活中的挑战增加时，症状可能会变得更加严重。

ADHD症状会根据许多因素波动，包括一个人是在学校还是在家，是否睡眠充足，是否承受很大压力，或者是否在服用药物或其他物质。例如，一个有轻度ADHD的人在度假并且休息良好时可能不会经历很多症状，但如果他们有一份要求很高的工作或学校日程，并且没有得到足够的睡眠，他们可能会有影响生活的症状。这些人在某些情况下可能需要ADHD治疗，但在其他情况下可能无需治疗就能很好地应对。

这与高血压等疾病的情况类似，高血压可能会因一个人的饮食、压力水平和许多其他因素而在日常或每月之间变化。

ADHD症状通常在儿童早期开始，并在儿童中期到晚期时达到最严重。因此，平均诊断年龄在9到12岁之间。这个年龄段也是儿童从小学过渡到中学的时期，他们可能还会经历环境变化，从而加重他们的症状。

从五年级开始，课程可能比早期年级更具挑战性。此外，过渡到中学通常意味着孩子们从由一位老师在一个教室里教授所有科目，转变为每节课都要换教室和不同的老师。这些变化可能会加剧之前控制良好的症状。

症状也可能在一生中波动。对于大多数人来说，症状在25岁后会有所改善——但可能不会完全消失——这也是大脑通常完成发育的时期。

与ADHD常常共存的精神问题，如焦虑或抑郁，可能会加重已经存在的ADHD症状。这些情况也可能模仿ADHD症状，使得很难知道应该治疗哪种情况。高水平的压力导致睡眠质量下降，以及工作或学校的要求增加，也可能加重或引起类似ADHD的症状。

最后，某些物质的使用，如大麻或镇静剂，可能会加重甚至引起ADHD症状。除了使已经被诊断为ADHD的人症状加重外，这些因素还可能使那些有轻微症状的人在短时间内发展为完全的ADHD。

反之亦然：一旦去除外部原因，ADHD的症状可以在不符合完整诊断标准的人身上得到最小化或逆转。

临床医生根据注意力不集中、过度活跃和冲动的症状来诊断ADHD。要在儿童中做出ADHD诊断，必须在这三类中的至少一类中出现六个或更多症状。对于成年人，要求五个或更多症状，但这些症状必须在儿童时期开始。对于所有年龄段，症状必须在生活的至少两个领域（如家庭、学校或工作）中造成严重问题。

目前的估计显示，儿童中ADHD的严格患病率约为5%。在年轻成年人中，这一数字降至3%，而在60岁以上的人群中则低于1%。研究人员使用“严格患病率”一词来表示根据流行病学研究满足ADHD所有标准的人的百分比。这是一个重要的数字，因为它为临床医生和科学家提供了在特定人群中预计有多少人会患有ADHD的估计。

相比之下，“诊断患病率”是指根据医疗专业人员的实际评估被诊断为ADHD的人的百分比。在美国和加拿大，18岁以下儿童的诊断患病率范围从7.5%到11.1%。这些比例远高于5%的严格患病率。

一些研究人员声称，诊断患病率与严格患病率之间的差异意味着ADHD被过度诊断。

我们不同意这一观点。在临床实践中，诊断规则允许患者在有大多数导致痛苦、功能障碍或两者的症状时被诊断为ADHD，即使他们不符合完整标准。而且大量证据表明，诊断患病率的增加可以归因于对之前可能被遗漏的轻度病例的诊断。这些轻度诊断的有效性有充分的文献支持。

考虑一下那些有五个注意力不集中症状和五个过度活跃-冲动症状的儿童。这些儿童将不符合ADHD的严格诊断标准。

title: A Global Prospective Harmonization Framework for Suicidality, Anhedonia, and Obsessive-Compulsive Symptoms in Psychiatric Genetic Studies: A Cross-Continental Study Within the Ancestral Population Network.
body: This study aims to prospectively collect harmonized, quantitative, and dimensional psychiatric phenotypes (suicidality, anhedonia, and obsessive-compulsive symptoms) and information on discrimination, stigma, and unfair treatment in up to 27,500 individuals across diverse ancestries and clinical populations for genetic analysis within the NIMH Ancestral Population Network (APN). Five APN projects are participating in the current study (PUMAS-Paisa, PUMAS-NeuroGAP, KOMOGEN-D, LATINO, and SAX-II), spanning recruitment over 15 countries across the Americas, Africa, and Asia. Participants are being enrolled via the recruitment protocols specific to each participating project. The harmonized clinical battery includes the Columbia-Suicide Severity Scale, Snaith-Hamilton Pleasure Scale, and Florida Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory-II to assess suicidality, anhedonia, and obsessive-compulsive symptoms, respectively. Additionally, we use the Discrimination and Stigma Scale-Ultra Short to evaluate discrimination and stigma across cultures. This project is a pioneering effort to prospectively assess transdiagnostic phenotypes in large-scale, diverse ancestral and clinical populations (across different diagnoses) using a harmonized clinical battery, advancing genetic research in mental health in underrepresented populations.
journal: American journal of medical genetics. Part B, Neuropsychiatric genetics : the official publication of the International Society of Psychiatric Genetics
authors: Diaz-Zuluaga AM, Anderberg JL, Ramirez-Diaz AM, Marques AH, Rast CE, Bustamante D, Jonker D, Valencia-Echeverry J, Kyebuzibwa J, Muñoz JS, van der Walt K, Ramirez MC, Wootton O, Frederick RM, Stroud RE, Gur R, Rhee SJ, J

title_zh: 全球精神病遗传研究中的自杀倾向、快感缺失与强迫症状的统一框架
summary_zh: 本研究旨在前瞻性地收集统一的、定量的、维度化的精神病表型（自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状），以及关于歧视、污名和不公平对待的信息，涉及多达27,500名来自不同血统和临床人群的个体，进行NIMH祖先人群网络（APN）内的遗传分析。参与本研究的五个APN项目（PUMAS-Paisa、PUMAS-NeuroGAP、KOMOGEN-D、LATINO和SAX-II）覆盖美洲、非洲和亚洲的15个国家。参与者通过各项目特定的招募协议进行招募。统一的临床评估工具包括哥伦比亚自杀严重程度量表、斯奈斯-汉密尔顿快感量表和佛罗里达强迫症清单-II，分别用于评估自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状。此外，我们使用歧视与污名量表-超短版评估不同文化中的歧视和污名。该项目是首次在大规模、多样的祖先和临床人群中前瞻性评估跨诊断表型的开创性努力，推动了在弱势人群中精神健康遗传研究的发展。
l1_lead: 本研究首次在大规模、多样的祖先和临床人群中前瞻性评估自杀倾向、快感缺失与强迫症状的统一框架，推动精神健康遗传研究的发展。
l2_summary:
本研究旨在前瞻性地收集统一的、定量的、维度化的精神病表型，包括自杀倾向（suicidal ideation）、快感缺失（anhedonia）和强迫症状（obsessive-compulsive symptoms），并探讨歧视、污名和不公平对待对这些表型的影响。研究涉及多达27,500名来自不同血统和临床人群的个体，进行NIMH祖先人群网络（APN）内的遗传分析。参与本研究的五个APN项目（PUMAS-Paisa、PUMAS-NeuroGAP、KOMOGEN-D、LATINO和SAX-II）覆盖美洲、非洲和亚洲的15个国家，体现了样本的多样性和广泛性。参与者通过各项目特定的招募协议进行招募，确保了数据的代表性。

研究中使用的统一临床评估工具包括哥伦比亚自杀严重程度量表（Columbia-Suicide Severity Rating Scale）、斯奈斯-汉密尔顿快感量表（Snaith-Hamilton Pleasure Scale）和佛罗里达强迫症清单-II（Florida Obsessive-Compulsive Inventory-II），分别用于评估自杀倾向、快感缺失和强迫症状。此外，研究还使用歧视与污名量表-超短版（Discrimination and Stigma Scale-Short Version）来评估不同文化中的歧视和污名现象。

该项目是首次在大规模、多样的祖先和临床人群中前瞻性评估跨诊断表型的开创性努力，推动了在弱势人群中精神健康遗传研究的发展。通过对这些精神病表型的系统性分析，研究不仅为理解精神健康问题的遗传基础提供了新的视角，也为制定针对性干预措施奠定了基础。这项研究的成果将有助于提升对精神健康问题的认识，减少歧视和污名，促进社会对精神疾病患者的支持与理解。

title: Genetic Evidence for a Neuroimmune Model of Schizophrenia.
body: Since the early 1900s, clinical and epidemiological observations have suggested a link between schizophrenia and the immune system, yet genetic evidence for a pathophysiological connection has remained elusive. Here, we review evidence for immune involvement from a variety of genetic studies to characterize the contribution of genetic variation in immune genes and pathways to schizophrenia risk. Across studies, the strongest and most consistent associations remain in neuronal pathways, but several studies have revealed involvement of peripheral lymphocyte populations, including CD4+ T cells, mature B cells, and, to a lesser extent, natural killer (NK) cells. Cross-trait genetic analyses are mixed but point to a modest shared genetic architecture between schizophrenia and several immune traits. Collectively, current evidence supports a primarily neuronal genetic architecture for schizophrenia with a modest immunogenetic component. Advancing our understanding of the immune contribution to schizophrenia risk will require integration of genomic, proteomic, and deep immunophenotyping approaches to capture these subtle and dynamic processes. Ultimately, combining genetic, immunologic, and clinical data will be essential for improving diagnostic precision, identifying novel therapeutic targets, and tailoring treatment to individual biological profiles.
authors: van der Walt K, Stein DJ, Zoghbi AW.
title_zh: 精神分裂症的神经免疫模型的遗传证据
summary_zh: 自20世纪初以来，临床和流行病学观察表明精神分裂症与免疫系统之间存在联系，但遗传证据仍然稀缺。本文回顾了多项遗传研究中免疫参与的证据，旨在表征免疫基因和通路的遗传变异对精神分裂症风险的贡献。研究显示，最强且一致的关联主要集中在神经通路上，但也有研究揭示外周淋巴细胞群体（如CD4+ T细胞、成熟B细胞及自然杀伤（NK）细胞）参与其中。跨性状遗传分析结果不一，但指向精神分裂症与多种免疫特征之间存在适度的共享遗传结构。总体而言，现有证据支持精神分裂症主要由神经遗传结构主导，并具有适度的免疫遗传成分。深入理解免疫对精神分裂症风险的贡献需要整合基因组学、蛋白组学和深度免疫表型分析，以捕捉这些微妙而动态的过程。最终，结合遗传、免疫和临床数据对于提高诊断精度、识别新治疗靶点及个性化治疗至关重要。
l1_lead: 精神分裂症的遗传研究表明，神经遗传结构主导其风险，同时存在适度的免疫遗传成分，强调整合多学科数据以改善诊断和治疗。
l2_summary:
自20世纪初以来，精神分裂症（Schizophrenia）与免疫系统之间的关系逐渐受到关注，尽管相关的遗传证据仍然相对稀缺。本文回顾了多项遗传研究中关于免疫参与的证据，旨在探讨免疫基因及其通路的遗传变异对精神分裂症风险的影响。研究发现，精神分裂症的最强且一致的遗传关联主要集中在神经通路上，但也有证据表明外周淋巴细胞群体（如CD4+ T细胞、成熟B细胞及自然杀伤（NK）细胞）在这一过程中发挥了作用。此外，跨性状遗传分析的结果虽然不尽相同，但普遍指向精神分裂症与多种免疫特征之间存在适度的共享遗传结构。

总体来看，现有的证据支持精神分裂症主要由神经遗传结构主导，同时也具有适度的免疫遗传成分。为了深入理解免疫对精神分裂症风险的贡献，研究者们建议整合基因组学、蛋白组学和深度免疫表型分析，以捕捉这些复杂而动态的生物过程。最终，将遗传、免疫和临床数据结合起来，对于提高精神分裂症的诊断精度、识别新的治疗靶点以及实现个性化治疗具有重要意义。这一研究方向不仅为精神分裂症的病因提供了新的视角，也为未来的治疗策略开辟了新的可能性。

title: Body-Focused Repetitive Behavior Disorders: From Competing Paradigms Toward Iterative Integration.
body: Body-focused repetitive behaviors (BFRBs), such as hair-pulling and skin-picking, have been described by physicians from Hippocrates onward. The descriptions have not been theory-neutral; clinicians and researchers have applied specific conceptual frameworks to understand such behaviors and to intervene accordingly. These include what might be termed "turns" to psychoanalysis, cognitive behaviorism, psychopharmacology, nosology, neuroscience, consumer advocacy, and global mental health. It is timely to consider lessons learned from this range of conceptual frameworks, each of which has both strengths and limitations. Rather than advocating for yet another paradigm shift to advance knowledge and treatment of BFRBs, we suggest that scientific pluralism is useful for clinicians and researchers and potentially allows iterative and integrative progress in this field.
authors: Stein DJ, Lochner C.
title_zh: 聚焦身体的重复行为障碍：从竞争范式到迭代整合
summary_zh: 身体聚焦重复行为（BFRBs），如拔头发和抠皮肤，自古希腊时期的希波克拉底以来便受到医生的关注。对此的描述并非中立，临床医生和研究人员运用了多种概念框架来理解这些行为并进行干预，包括精神分析、认知行为主义、精神药理学、分类学、神经科学、消费者倡导和全球心理健康等。本文认为，借鉴这些框架的经验教训是及时的，因为每种框架都有其优缺点。我们建议，不必再倡导另一种范式转变来推动BFRBs的知识和治疗进展，而是应提倡科学的多元主义，这对临床医生和研究人员有益，并可能在该领域实现迭代和整合的进步。
l1_lead: 本文建议在研究和治疗身体聚焦重复行为障碍时，应倡导科学的多元主义，而非单一范式转变，以促进知识和治疗的迭代整合进展。
l2_summary:
身体聚焦重复行为障碍（BFRBs），如拔头发（trichotillomania）和抠皮肤（dermatillomania），自古希腊时期的希波克拉底以来便引起了医学界的关注。这些行为的描述并非中立，临床医生和研究人员采用了多种概念框架来理解和干预这些行为，包括精神分析、认知行为主义、精神药理学、分类学、神经科学、消费者倡导以及全球心理健康等。每种框架都有其独特的视角和方法，但也存在各自的局限性。

本文提出，借鉴这些不同框架的经验教训是十分必要的，因为它们为理解BFRBs提供了多样的视角。作者认为，当前不应再提倡另一种范式转变来推动BFRBs的知识和治疗进展，而是应倡导科学的多元主义。这种多元主义不仅能为临床医生和研究人员提供更为丰富的工具和视角，还可能在该领域实现迭代和整合的进步。

通过整合不同的理论和实践，研究者和临床医生能够更全面地理解BFRBs的复杂性，从而制定出更有效的干预措施。这种方法强调了不同框架之间的互补性，鼓励在研究和治疗中采用跨学科的视角，以便更好地应对这一领域的挑战。总之，推动BFRBs的研究和治疗进展，需要在多元化的理论框架中寻找共通之处，以实现更为有效的临床应用和科学探索。

title: Inpatient hospital admissions for people with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). A position statement by the international college of obsessive-compulsive spectrum disorders.
body: Background The hospitalization of patients with obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) is less common in comparison to other mental disorders, and often a significant and distressing event. Objectives This paper presents a position statement, developed by the International College of Obsessive-Compulsive Spectrum Disorders, on the indications for hospital admission for people with OCD, the treatment that is offered within hospital, the complications that may occur in this setting, and principles for best practice. Methods Current literature was critically reviewed and narratively synthesized by a group of international experts in the field of OCD. Results An inpatient hospital admission may be required for people with severe OCD who are unable to accept or tolerate pharmacological or psychological treatment as an outpatient or where there would be significant risks to the individual or those around them. Admissions have been associated with significant reductions in OCD severity. Inpatient treatment often involves psychoeducation of staff, patients and family members, pharmacotherapy, exposure and response prevention psychological work, addressing comorbidity as well as psychosocial issues such as family-relational issues, homelessness, grief or loss. Admissions can be distressing, and intensive inpatient-based therapy programs require the comprehensive assessment of risk. Conclusions The inpatient treatment of people with OCD is an important management option that needs to be well considered and managed. Admissions often require close monitoring of risks, additional support to staff who may be unfamiliar with OCD, addressing comorbidity, pharmacotherapy and exposure and response prevention therapy.
authors: Brakoulias V, Albert U, Chamberlain SR, Dell'Osso B, Ferretti CJ, Girone N, Hollander E, Ioannidis K, Lochner C, Menchon JM, Mpavaenda D, Pallanti S, Pampaloni I, Pellegrini L, Stein DJ, Van Ameringen M, Zohar J, Fineber
title_zh: 强迫症患者住院治疗的必要性与最佳实践
summary_zh: 本文由国际强迫症谱系障碍学院提出，探讨了强迫症（OCD）患者住院治疗的适应症、医院内提供的治疗、可能出现的并发症及最佳实践原则。研究表明，严重强迫症患者若无法接受或耐受门诊的药物或心理治疗，或存在对自身及他人显著风险时，可能需要住院治疗。住院治疗与强迫症严重程度显著降低相关。住院治疗通常包括对医务人员、患者及其家属的心理教育、药物治疗、暴露与反应预防（exposure and response prevention）心理工作、共病及心理社会问题的处理，如家庭关系、无家可归、悲伤或失落等。住院治疗可能带来痛苦，且密集的住院治疗方案需进行全面的风险评估。
l1_lead: 严重强迫症患者在无法耐受门诊治疗或存在风险时，住院治疗可显著降低症状，并需综合考虑心理教育、药物治疗及心理社会问题。
l2_summary:
本文由国际强迫症谱系障碍学院提出，探讨了强迫症（OCD）患者住院治疗的必要性与最佳实践。研究表明，对于严重强迫症患者，若其无法接受或耐受门诊的药物或心理治疗，或存在对自身及他人显著风险时，住院治疗是必要的。住院治疗与强迫症的严重程度显著降低相关，这一发现强调了住院治疗在管理重症患者中的重要性。

住院治疗通常包括多方面的干预措施，首先是对医务人员、患者及其家属进行心理教育，以帮助他们理解强迫症的特征和治疗过程。此外，药物治疗是住院治疗的重要组成部分，常常与暴露与反应预防（exposure and response prevention）心理工作相结合，以帮助患者逐步面对其强迫症状而不进行强迫行为。同时，住院治疗还需关注共病及心理社会问题的处理，例如家庭关系、无家可归、悲伤或失落等，这些因素可能会影响患者的康复进程。

然而，住院治疗也可能带来一定的痛苦，且由于其密集性，需进行全面的风险评估，以确保患者在治疗过程中得到适当的支持和照顾。因此，制定最佳实践原则显得尤为重要，以确保住院治疗的有效性和安全性。总之，住院治疗在严重强迫症患者的管理中扮演着关键角色，能够显著改善患者的症状和生活质量。

title: Placebo and nocebo effects of pharmacotherapy for obsessive-compulsive related disorders: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
body: Objective This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to quantify the magnitude of placebo and nocebo effects in pharmacological trials for OCRDs and identify clinical and methodological moderators influencing these effects. Methods A comprehensive literature search was conducted across multiple databases and clinical trial registries up to May 2025. Randomised, placebo-controlled trials involving pharmacological interventions for OCRDs were included. The primary outcomes were placebo effect size and placebo response rate; secondary outcomes included nocebo response rate and side effect profile. Data were extracted independently and meta-analysed using random effects models. Meta-regression was performed to assess moderators of placebo response. Results Fifteen eligible trials ( N = 640; placebo N = 341) were included. The pooled placebo effect size was moderate (SMC = -0.63; 95% CI -0.77 to -0.48), with low heterogeneity ( I 2 = 4.73%). The placebo response rate was 21%, and the nocebo response rate was 18%. Despite testing a broad range of potential moderators, including clinical characteristics, methodological design, and medication class, no significant predictors of placebo effect size were identified. Side effects were reported in nearly one-third of placebo recipients, underscoring the relevance of nocebo effects. Conclusions Placebo and nocebo responses are noteworthy in trials for OCRDs and may influence perceived treatment efficacy. Variability in placebo responses is not well explained by currently measurable moderators. Further research is needed to explore neurobiological, psychological, and methodological contributors to expectancy effects in OCRD pharmacotherapy trials.
authors: Hoffman J, Williams T, Stein DJ.
title_zh: 强迫症相关障碍药物治疗的安慰剂与反安慰剂效应系统评估
summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在量化强迫症相关障碍（OCRDs）药物试验中的安慰剂（placebo）和反安慰剂（nocebo）效应，并识别影响这些效应的临床和方法学调节因素。通过对多个数据库和临床试验注册中心进行全面文献检索，共纳入15项随机对照试验（N = 640；安慰剂组N = 341）。结果显示，安慰剂效应大小为中等（SMC = -0.63；95% CI -0.77至-0.48），异质性低（I² = 4.73%），安慰剂反应率为21%，反安慰剂反应率为18%。尽管测试了多种潜在调节因素，但未发现显著的安慰剂效应大小预测因子。近三分之一的安慰剂接受者报告了副作用，强调了反安慰剂效应的重要性。结论显示安慰剂和反安慰剂反应值得关注。
l1_lead: 强迫症相关障碍药物治疗中，安慰剂效应显著且中等，反安慰剂效应同样重要，需关注其对临床结果的影响。
l2_summary: 本研究旨在系统评估强迫症相关障碍（OCRDs）药物治疗中的安慰剂（placebo）和反安慰剂（nocebo）效应，并量化其影响。通过对多个数据库和临床试验注册中心进行全面文献检索，研究纳入了15项随机对照试验，总样本量为640人，其中安慰剂组有341人。结果显示，安慰剂效应的效应大小为中等，标准化均差（SMC）为-0.63，95%置信区间为-0.77至-0.48，且异质性较低（I² = 4.73%）。在所有参与者中，安慰剂反应率为21%，而反安慰剂反应率则为18%。尽管研究测试了多种潜在的调节因素，但未能发现显著的安慰剂效应大小预测因子，这表明影响安慰剂效应的因素可能较为复杂。此外，近三分之一的安慰剂接受者报告了副作用，这突显了反安慰剂效应的重要性。综上所述，安慰剂和反安慰剂反应在强迫症相关障碍的药物治疗中值得关注，提示临床实践中需重视这些效应对患者治疗体验的影响。

title: Neurorestorative properties of ibogaine: linking multi-receptor affinities to remyelination and metabolic restoration.
body: Ibogaine is a psychedelic alkaloid without an approved indication. Observational clinical research shows linkages between single administration of ibogaine and relief of symptoms of neuropsychiatric conditions including substance use disorder, multiple sclerosis (MS), and traumatic brain injury. Ibogaine has multi-receptor actions, but the neurobiological mechanisms underlying such putative effects are unknown. Here we review and discuss the relevant literature, focusing on remyelination and metabolic restoration. We provide evidence that ibogaine upregulates markers of myelination following opioid administration; that conditions such as opioid use disorder, MS and traumatic brain injury are characterised by white matter pathology; that decreased myelination is related to dysregulated metabolic homeostasis, ischaemia and hypoxia which may also play a role in these disorders. We conclude that multi-receptor actions of ibogaine, especially its affinities for the NMDA, kappa opioid and sigma receptors, in turn account for reduction in excitotoxicity, metabolic regulation, lasting neuroplasticity and immunomodulation that facilitates neuronal repair and remyelination providing a rationale for future investigation of its use as a therapeutic agent for these common central nervous system disorders.
authors: Calvey T, Govender D, Owen GR, Tumba N, Lang D, Lerer B, Stein DJ, Shoptaw S.
title_zh: 伊博卡因的神经修复特性：多受体亲和力与再髓鞘化及代谢恢复的关联
summary_zh: 伊博卡因是一种尚未获得批准的迷幻生物碱。观察性临床研究显示，单次使用伊博卡因与缓解神经精神疾病症状（如物质使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤）存在关联。本文回顾并讨论相关文献，重点关注再髓鞘化和代谢恢复。我们提供证据表明，伊博卡因在阿片类药物使用后上调髓鞘化标志物；阿片类药物使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤等病症特征为白质病理；髓鞘化减少与代谢稳态失调、缺血和缺氧相关，这些因素可能在这些疾病中发挥作用。我们得出结论，伊博卡因的多受体作用，尤其是其对NMDA、κ阿片和σ受体的亲和力，能够减少兴奋性毒性、调节代谢、促进持久的神经可塑性和免疫调节，从而促进神经修复和再髓鞘化，为其作为治疗这些常见中枢神经系统疾病的药物提供了未来研究的依据。
l1_lead: 伊博卡因通过多受体作用促进神经修复和再髓鞘化，显示出其在治疗神经精神疾病中的潜力。
l2_summary:
伊博卡因是一种尚未获得批准的迷幻生物碱，近年来的观察性临床研究表明，单次使用伊博卡因与缓解多种神经精神疾病症状（如物质使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤）存在显著关联。本文回顾并讨论了相关文献，重点关注伊博卡因在再髓鞘化和代谢恢复方面的潜在作用。研究提供的证据显示，伊博卡因能够在阿片类药物使用后上调髓鞘化标志物，这一发现与阿片类药物使用障碍、多发性硬化症和创伤性脑损伤等病症的白质病理特征密切相关。髓鞘化减少通常与代谢稳态失调、缺血和缺氧等因素有关，这些因素在上述疾病的发展中可能发挥重要作用。

通过分析伊博卡因的多受体作用，尤其是其对NMDA（N-甲基-D-天冬氨酸）、κ阿片和σ受体的亲和力，研究表明，伊博卡因能够有效减少兴奋性毒性，调节代谢，促进持久的神经可塑性和免疫调节。这些机制共同促进了神经修复和再髓鞘化的过程，为伊博卡因作为治疗这些常见中枢神经系统疾病的潜在药物提供了重要的研究依据。综上所述，伊博卡因的神经修复特性及其与再髓鞘化和代谢恢复的关联，值得进一步深入研究，以期为相关疾病的治疗提供新的思路和方法。

title: Are you on the internet or using screen-based devices?
body: The concept of 'internet addiction' was introduced in the 1990s and has increasingly been recognized as a clinical and public health issue. Although umbrella terms can be useful for screening, theoretical considerations, and intervention planning, the term itself has received criticism because of its conceptual heterogeneity, implying an addiction to a medium and not including a wide range of problematic behavioral patterns that are below the diagnostic threshold of a clinical disorder. To address this criticism, we propose adopting the term 'problematic use' instead of 'addiction'. Furthermore, we argue that while 'problematic usage of the internet' is currently a useful umbrella term, recent technological advancements and increasing online presence may in the future require a conceptual and methodological shift in terminology from 'internet' to the more specific 'screen-based devices' or 'screens' that would enable more accurate assessment and intervention strategies. Terms focusing on specific devices, such as 'smartphone addiction,' should also be used with caution, as problematic use relates to applications rather than the hardware itself and may extend to various devices.
authors: Demetrovics Z, Czakó A, Potenza MN, Griffiths MD, Fineberg NA, Stein DJ, Ekhtiari H, Brand M, Montag C, Lin CY, Li L, Elhai JD, Király O.
title_zh: 互联网使用与屏幕设备的“问题性使用”探讨
summary_zh: 自1990年代提出“互联网成瘾”概念以来，该问题逐渐被视为临床和公共健康问题。尽管这一统称有助于筛查和干预规划，但因其概念异质性受到批评，未能涵盖低于临床障碍诊断阈值的多种行为模式。为此，文章建议使用“问题性使用”一词替代“成瘾”。同时，作者指出，随着技术进步和在线活动的增加，未来可能需要将术语从“互联网”转向更具体的“屏幕设备”或“屏幕”，以便更准确地评估和制定干预策略。此外，针对特定设备的术语，如“智能手机成瘾”，也应谨慎使用，因为问题性使用与应用程序相关，而非硬件本身，且可能涉及多种设备。
l1_lead: 文章建议用“问题性使用”替代“互联网成瘾”，并强调未来应关注“屏幕设备”以更准确评估和干预相关行为。
l2_summary:
自1990年代提出“互联网成瘾”（Internet Addiction）概念以来，该问题逐渐被视为临床和公共健康领域的重要议题。尽管这一统称在筛查和干预规划中发挥了一定作用，但由于其概念的异质性，受到了一些批评，未能全面涵盖低于临床障碍诊断阈值的多种行为模式。因此，文章建议使用“问题性使用”（Problematic Use）一词来替代“成瘾”，以更准确地描述相关行为。

随着技术的进步和在线活动的增加，未来可能需要将术语从“互联网”转向更具体的“屏幕设备”（Screen Devices）或“屏幕”（Screen），以便更有效地评估和制定干预策略。这一转变反映了现代社会中多样化的数字设备使用情况，强调了对不同设备使用行为的细致分析。此外，针对特定设备的术语，如“智能手机成瘾”（Smartphone Addiction），也应谨慎使用，因为问题性使用往往与应用程序的使用相关，而非硬件本身，且可能涉及多种设备的交互作用。

综上所述，文章强调了在研究和干预中采用更为精确的术语的重要性，以便更好地理解和应对与屏幕设备相关的使用问题。这一观点为未来的研究提供了新的方向，促使学术界和公共健康领域在应对数字时代的挑战时，能够更有效地制定策略和实施干预措施。

title: Executive functioning in adolescents with internalizing disorders: a systematic review.
body: Internalizing disorders (INTs), including anxiety (AD) and depressive disorders (DD), frequently emerge during adolescence. Studies suggest that certain core domains of executive functioning (EF), i.e. inhibition, shifting and working memory (WM) may show selectively lower performance in certain INTs. This systematic review aimed to evaluate the evidence of associations between INTs and EF in adolescents. A systematic search was conducted in Medline, Psych-INFO, Scopus, and Web of Science in May 2023. Inclusion focused on adolescents (12-17) with AD (including obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD)) or DD. After screening 2,551 titles/abstracts, 818 records underwent full-text review, on which independent reviewers reached 93% agreement on eligibility. EF parameters, measured through task-performance or ratings, were extracted from 32 eligible articles published since 2014. Performance-based EF differences were reported in 22 studies, most frequently in adolescents with DD. Task-based inhibition showed lower scores most consistently in DD (n = 5). Findings were mixed across other INTs. Three studies found evidence for improved inhibition performance in OCD (n = 2) and AD (n = 1). Finally, 6 studies reporting on self- or parent-rated EF found significant difficulties across EF domains, of which 3 contrasted with intact performances on task-based measurements of EF. Findings suggest both objective and subjective EF difficulties across INTs with no conclusive evidence for selective domain-specific differences. We highlight a discrepancy between subjectively experienced or observed deficits in daily EF and performance on structured tasks. This suggests that rating-based EF may be more sensitive for capturing subtle EF difficulties and therefore adds value in research and clinical settings. Finally, the quality of studies is discussed and directions for future studies are identified, namely, the use of both task and rating-based measures of EF as well as inclusion of larger sample sizes.
authors: Fontaine GP, Blake KV, Koen N, Stein DJ, Hammar Å, Groenewold NA.
title_zh: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能的系统评估
summary_zh: 内化障碍（INTs），包括焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD），常在青少年时期出现。本系统评审旨在评估青少年内化障碍与执行功能（EF）之间的关联证据。研究通过对2014年以来的32篇符合条件的文章进行分析，发现执行功能的核心领域，如抑制、转换和工作记忆，在某些内化障碍中表现出选择性较低的表现。22项研究报告了基于表现的执行功能差异，尤其是在抑郁障碍青少年中最为明显。抑制任务在抑郁障碍中显示出一致的低分（n = 5）。其他内化障碍的结果则较为混杂。三项研究发现强迫症（OCD）和焦虑障碍的抑制表现有所改善。最后，6项关于自评或父母评估的研究显示在执行功能各领域存在显著困难，其中3项与任务表现的完整性相对立。
l1_lead: 青少年内化障碍与执行功能之间存在显著关联，尤其在抑郁障碍中，执行功能表现较差，且自评和父母评估显示执行功能困难。
l2_summary:
本系统评审旨在探讨青少年内化障碍（INTs）与执行功能（EF）之间的关系，特别关注焦虑障碍（AD）和抑郁障碍（DD）在这一领域的表现。研究分析了自2014年以来的32篇相关文献，结果显示执行功能的核心领域，包括抑制、转换和工作记忆，在某些内化障碍中表现出选择性较低的表现。具体而言，22项研究报告了基于表现的执行功能差异，尤其是在抑郁障碍青少年中，这种差异最为明显。抑郁障碍青少年在抑制任务中的表现一致较低，相关研究显示有5项研究得出了这一结论。

此外，其他内化障碍的结果则相对混杂。例如，三项研究发现强迫症（OCD）和焦虑障碍的抑制表现有所改善，表明在不同类型的内化障碍中，执行功能的表现可能存在差异。值得注意的是，6项关于自评或父母评估的研究显示，在执行功能的各个领域中，青少年普遍存在显著困难，其中有3项研究的结果与任务表现的完整性相对立，提示自我评估和他人评估之间可能存在不一致性。

综上所述，青少年内化障碍与执行功能之间的关联是复杂的，尤其是在抑郁障碍中表现尤为突出。研究结果强调了在评估青少年心理健康时，考虑执行功能的必要性，并指出了未来研究中需要进一步探讨的方向。

title: Consortium profile: the methylation, imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) consortium.
body: Epigenetic processes, such as DNA methylation, show potential as biological markers and mechanisms underlying gene-environment interplay in the prediction of mental health and other brain-based phenotypes. However, little is known about how peripheral epigenetic patterns relate to individual differences in the brain itself. An increasingly popular approach to address this is by combining epigenetic and neuroimaging data; yet, research in this area is almost entirely comprised of cross-sectional studies in adults. To bridge this gap, we established the Methylation, Imaging and NeuroDevelopment (MIND) Consortium, which aims to bring a developmental focus to the emerging field of Neuroimaging Epigenetics by (i) promoting collaborative, adequately powered developmental research via multi-cohort analyses; (ii) increasing scientific rigor through the establishment of shared pipelines and open science practices; and (iii) advancing our understanding of DNA methylation-brain dynamics at different developmental periods (from birth to emerging adulthood), by leveraging data from prospective, longitudinal pediatric studies. MIND currently integrates 16 cohorts worldwide, comprising (repeated) measures of DNA methylation in peripheral tissues (blood, buccal cells, and saliva) and neuroimaging by magnetic resonance imaging across up to five time points over a period of up to 21 years (N pooled DNAm = 12,877; N pooled neuroimaging = 10,899; N pooled combined = 6074). By triangulating associations across multiple developmental time points and study types, we hope to generate new insights into the dynamic relationships between peripheral DNA methylation and the brain, and how these ultimately relate to neurodevelopmental and psychiatric phenotypes.
authors: Schuurmans IK, Mulder RH, Baltramonaityte V, Lahtinen A, Qiuyu F, Rothmann LM, Staginnus M, Tuulari JJ, Burt SA, Buss C, Craig JM, Donald KA, Eriksson JG, Felix JF, Freeman TP, Grassi-Oliveira R, Huels A, Hyde LW, Jones

title_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟概况
summary_zh: 甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟旨在通过结合表观遗传学（epigenetics）和神经成像（neuroimaging）数据，探讨外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的关系。尽管DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）作为生物标志物在心理健康和脑基因表型预测中显示出潜力，但目前的研究主要集中在成人的横断面研究。MIND联盟通过多队列分析促进协作研究，建立共享流程和开放科学实践，增强科学严谨性，并利用前瞻性、纵向的儿童研究数据，深入理解不同发育阶段（从出生到成年初期）DNA甲基化与大脑动态的关系。目前，MIND整合了全球16个队列的数据，涵盖了外周组织（血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中的DNA甲基化测量和多达五个时间点的磁共振成像（MRI）数据，研究时间跨度可达21年。
l1_lead: MIND联盟通过整合全球多队列的DNA甲基化和神经成像数据，深入探讨外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异的关系，推动儿童至成年早期的纵向研究。
l2_summary:
甲基化、成像与神经发育（MIND）联盟致力于探讨外周表观遗传模式与大脑个体差异之间的关系，结合表观遗传学（epigenetics）和神经成像（neuroimaging）数据，旨在深入理解DNA甲基化（DNA methylation）在心理健康和脑基因表型预测中的潜力。尽管现有研究主要集中在成人的横断面分析，MIND联盟通过多队列分析促进协作研究，建立共享流程和开放科学实践，以增强科学的严谨性。该联盟利用前瞻性、纵向的儿童研究数据，关注从出生到成年初期不同发育阶段中DNA甲基化与大脑动态的关系。

目前，MIND联盟整合了全球16个队列的数据，涵盖了外周组织（如血液、口腔细胞和唾液）中的DNA甲基化测量，并收集了多达五个时间点的磁共振成像（MRI）数据，研究时间跨度可达21年。这种大规模的数据整合为研究提供了丰富的样本和时间维度，使得科学家能够更全面地分析和理解不同发育阶段中表观遗传因素如何影响大脑结构和功能的变化。

通过这样的研究框架，MIND联盟不仅推动了对儿童和青少年心理健康的理解，也为未来的干预措施和治疗策略提供了重要的理论基础。该联盟的工作强调了跨学科合作的重要性，促进了表观遗传学与神经科学领域的交叉研究，为揭示复杂的生物学机制提供了新的视角。

title: Exploring the relationships between Early Childhood Adversity, Social Cognition, and Aggression in a South African Study of People Living with Schizophrenia.
body: People living with schizophrenia (PLS) are at increased risk of being both victims and perpetrators of violence. Recent research suggests that social cognitive impairments may contribute to heightened aggression in schizophrenia. Childhood trauma, a well-established risk factor for both schizophrenia and aggression, is also linked to more severe cognitive deficits in PLS. Few studies have explored the relationships between childhood trauma, social cognition, and aggression in large sample sizes, particularly in low- and middle-income settings, where varying socioeconomic factors and exposure to violence may influence these associations. In this study, a subsample of participants (PLS = 585; controls = 882) from the Genomics of Schizophrenia in the South African Xhosa People study completed The Childhood Trauma Questionnaire (CTQ), Penn Emotion Identification Test (ER), Life History of Aggression Questionnaire (LHA), and Structured Diagnostic Interview for DSM-IV Axis I Disorders. Group differences in CTQ, ER, LHA, and selected demographic and clinical factors were assessed using t -tests and chi-square tests. Multivariable linear regressions were employed to test for associations among CTQ, ER, and LHA. We found that PLS had significantly higher childhood trauma and lifetime aggression scores and poorer emotion recognition performance than controls. Higher childhood trauma was associated with higher lifetime aggression and worse emotion recognition performance. However, emotion recognition performance was not associated with lifetime aggression. In this setting, childhood trauma predicts lifetime aggression and poorer emotion recognition, but there is no evidence that emotion recognition ability is related to aggression.
authors: van der Walt K, Wootton O, Rokicki J, Vaskinn A, Jonker D, Campbell M, Susser E, Haukvik UK, Gur RC, Stein DJ, Friestad C.
title_zh: 南非精神分裂症患者早期逆境、社会认知与攻击性关系研究
summary_zh: 本研究探讨了生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）与早期儿童创伤、社会认知及攻击性之间的关系。研究表明，精神分裂症患者在暴力中既可能是受害者也可能是施害者，且社会认知缺陷可能加剧其攻击性。儿童创伤作为精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度相关。研究分析了585名PLS和882名对照组参与者的儿童创伤问卷（CTQ）、情感识别测试（ER）和攻击历史问卷（LHA）的数据。结果显示，PLS在儿童创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，且情感识别表现较差。研究强调了儿童创伤对精神分裂症患者社会认知和攻击性的重要影响。
l1_lead: 研究发现，南非精神分裂症患者的早期儿童创伤与其社会认知缺陷和攻击性显著相关，强调了创伤对其心理健康的深远影响。
l2_summary:
本研究旨在探讨生活在南非的精神分裂症患者（PLS）与早期儿童创伤、社会认知及攻击性之间的关系。研究发现，精神分裂症患者在暴力行为中既可能是受害者，也可能是施害者，而社会认知缺陷可能加剧其攻击性。儿童创伤被认为是精神分裂症和攻击性的已知风险因素，且与PLS的认知缺陷严重程度密切相关。

研究分析了585名PLS和882名对照组参与者的数据，使用了儿童创伤问卷（CTQ）、情感识别测试（ER）和攻击历史问卷（LHA）。结果显示，PLS在儿童创伤和终生攻击性评分上显著高于对照组，表明早期创伤经历可能与其攻击性行为有直接关联。此外，PLS在情感识别方面的表现也较差，进一步支持了社会认知缺陷与攻击性之间的联系。

综上所述，研究强调了儿童创伤对精神分裂症患者的社会认知和攻击性的重要影响，提示临床干预时应关注早期创伤经历，以改善患者的社会认知能力，降低攻击性行为的发生。这一发现为理解精神分裂症患者的行为模式提供了新的视角，也为未来的治疗策略提供了重要的参考依据。

title: Problematic usage of the internet: Converging and diverging terminologies and constructs.
body: Problematic usage of the internet (PUI) is an increasing global concern, leading to significant negative impacts in various levels. PUI is an umbrella term comprised of subcategories, including online gaming disorder, online gambling disorder, online buying-shopping disorder, online compulsive sexual behavior disorder, problematic usage of social media, cyberchondria, cyberbullying, and digital hoarding. With respect to the diversity of these categories, a factor that further impedes the field of PUI is not recognizing these subcategories under the PUI. To estimate the state of the field, we conducted a systematic review on a sample time frame, 2022-2023, and we found that among 2,497 relevant papers, only 13% of the studies on PUI subcategories used PUI as an umbrella term. Establishing PUI as an overarching terminology, as we do with substance use disorder (SUD) as a term while respecting the diversities within its subcategories, would synergize research efforts, facilitate comparisons, and inform treatment strategies. As technology continues to evolve, terminological refinement is critical to maintaining relevance and accessibility for researchers and the broader community.
authors: Zare-Bidoky M, Baldacchino AM, Baldacchino AM, Demetrovics Z, Fineberg NA, Kamali M, Khazaal Y, Potenza MN, Stein DJ, Ekhtiari H.
title_zh: 互联网问题使用的术语与构念的趋同与分歧
summary_zh: 互联网问题使用（Problematic usage of the internet, PUI）正日益成为全球关注的焦点，带来了显著的负面影响。PUI是一个涵盖多个子类别的总称，包括网络游戏障碍、网络赌博障碍、在线购物障碍、强迫性性行为障碍、社交媒体问题使用、网络病（cyberchondria）、网络欺凌和数字囤积等。研究发现，在2022-2023年间的2497篇相关论文中，仅有13%的研究将PUI作为总称使用。将PUI确立为一个总体术语，类似于物质使用障碍（Substance Use Disorder, SUD），并尊重其子类别的多样性，将有助于整合研究努力、促进比较以及指导治疗策略。随着技术的不断发展，术语的细化对于保持研究的相关性和可及性至关重要。
l1_lead: 将互联网问题使用（PUI）作为一个总体术语并尊重其子类别的多样性，有助于整合研究、促进比较和指导治疗策略，以应对其日益严重的负面影响。
l2_summary:
互联网问题使用（Problematic usage of the internet, PUI）正逐渐成为全球关注的热点，因其带来的显著负面影响而引发广泛讨论。PUI是一个涵盖多个子类别的总称，包括网络游戏障碍、网络赌博障碍、在线购物障碍、强迫性性行为障碍、社交媒体问题使用、网络病（cyberchondria）、网络欺凌和数字囤积等。根据对2022-2023年间2497篇相关论文的研究，仅有13%的研究将PUI作为一个总称使用，这表明在学术界对PUI的认识和应用仍存在较大分歧。

将PUI确立为一个总体术语，类似于物质使用障碍（Substance Use Disorder, SUD），并尊重其子类别的多样性，能够有效整合研究努力，促进不同研究之间的比较，并为治疗策略的制定提供指导。随着技术的不断发展，互联网使用问题的多样性和复杂性愈加明显，因此对相关术语的细化显得尤为重要。这不仅有助于保持研究的相关性和可及性，也为临床实践提供了更为清晰的框架。

综上所述，尽管PUI的研究尚处于起步阶段，但其重要性不容忽视。通过统一和细化相关术语，学术界能够更好地理解和应对互联网使用带来的各种问题，从而为个体和社会提供更有效的支持和干预措施。

title: New Genomics Discoveries Across the Bipolar Disorder Spectrum Implicate Neurobiological and Developmental Pathways.
body: Bipolar disorder (BD) is a highly heritable mental disorder that affects millions of people worldwide. Our understanding of the genetic etiology and biological processes that underlie BD have greatly increased in recent years. Extensive progress has been made in identifying common variant signals for BD, and the polygenic score from the latest genome-wide association study (GWAS) may provide some clinical utility if combined with other risk factors for BD. The role of rare variation in BD remains to be determined, although genes annotated to common variant loci are shown to be enriched for rare variation. BD subtypes have been shown to differ in their genetic architecture, and as such, genetic studies across the subtypes of the BD spectrum will identify subtype-specific signals and reveal subtype-specific biological mechanisms. Despite this, subtype-specific GWAS sample sizes have not increased at the same rate as BD cases, and more concerted efforts are required to obtain this information for participants included in future BD GWASs. Moreover, assessment of culture, geography, and other systematic differences that may impact patient assessment will be necessary to ensure accurate inclusion of diverse ancestral groups and global representation in genetic studies of BD moving forward.

title_zh: 新发现揭示双相障碍谱系中的神经生物学与发展路径
summary_zh: 双相障碍（BD）是一种高度遗传的精神疾病，影响全球数百万人的生活。近年来，我们对BD的遗传病因及其生物过程的理解显著提升。研究已在识别BD的常见变异信号方面取得了重大进展，最新的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）中的多基因评分若与其他风险因素结合，可能具有临床应用价值。尽管尚未确定稀有变异在BD中的作用，但与常见变异位点相关的基因显示出稀有变异的富集。不同BD亚型在遗传结构上存在差异，因此对BD谱系各亚型的遗传研究将识别特定信号并揭示特定的生物机制。然而，亚型特异性GWAS的样本量未能与BD病例的增长同步，未来需要更多的努力来获取相关信息。此外，评估文化、地理及其他系统性差异对于确保在BD的遗传研究中准确纳入多样的祖先群体和全球代表性至关重要。
l1_lead: 双相障碍的遗传研究进展显著，识别亚型特异性信号和稀有变异的作用将有助于揭示其生物机制，并推动临床应用的发展。
l2_summary:
双相障碍（BD）是一种高度遗传的精神疾病，影响全球数百万人的生活。近年来，科学界对BD的遗传病因及其生物过程的理解显著提升，尤其是在识别BD的常见变异信号方面取得了重大进展。最新的全基因组关联研究（GWAS）显示，若将多基因评分与其他风险因素结合，可能具有临床应用价值。这一发现为BD的早期诊断和个性化治疗提供了新的思路。

尽管目前尚未明确稀有变异在BD中的作用，但研究表明，与常见变异位点相关的基因中稀有变异的富集现象值得关注。此外，不同BD亚型在遗传结构上存在显著差异，这意味着对BD谱系各亚型的遗传研究将有助于识别特定的遗传信号，并揭示相应的生物机制。然而，当前亚型特异性GWAS的样本量未能与BD病例的增长同步，未来需要更多的研究努力来获取相关信息，以便更全面地理解BD的遗传基础。

此外，评估文化、地理及其他系统性差异对于确保在BD的遗传研究中准确纳入多样的祖先群体和全球代表性至关重要。这一方面的研究将有助于提高对BD的理解，确保研究结果的普遍适用性。因此，未来的研究不仅需要关注遗传因素，还应考虑环境和文化背景对BD的影响，以推动该领域的进一步发展。

title: A whole-brain voxel-based analysis of structural abnormalities in PTSD: An ENIGMA-PGC study.
body: Background Patients with posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD) exhibit smaller regional brain volumes in commonly reported regions including the amygdala and hippocampus, regions associated with fear and memory processing. In the current study, we have conducted a voxel-based morphometry (VBM) meta-analysis using whole-brain statistical maps with neuroimaging data from the ENIGMA-PGC PTSD working group. Methods T1-weighted structural neuroimaging scans from 36 cohorts (PTSD n = 1309; controls n = 2198) were processed using a standardized VBM pipeline (ENIGMA-VBM tool). We meta-analyzed the resulting statistical maps for voxel-wise differences in gray matter (GM) and white matter (WM) volumes between PTSD patients and controls, performed subgroup analyses considering the trauma exposure of the controls, and examined associations between regional brain volumes and clinical variables including PTSD (CAPS-4/5, PCL-5) and depression severity (BDI-II, PHQ-9). Results PTSD patients exhibited smaller GM volumes across the frontal and temporal lobes, and cerebellum, with the most significant effect in the left cerebellum (Hedges' g = 0.22, p corrected = .001), and smaller cerebellar WM volume (peak Hedges' g = 0.14, p corrected = .008). We observed similar regional differences when comparing patients to trauma-exposed controls, suggesting these structural abnormalities may be specific to PTSD. Regression analyses revealed PTSD severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum ( p corrected = .003), while depression severity was negatively associated with GM volumes within the cerebellum and superior frontal gyrus in patients ( p corrected = .001). Conclusions PTSD patients exhibited widespread, regional differences in brain volumes where greater regional deficits appeared to reflect more severe symptoms. Our findings add to the growing literature implicating the cerebellum in PTSD psychopathology.
journal: European psychiatry : the journal of the Association of European Psychiatrists
