title_zh: 创伤后应激障碍的全脑体素分析：ENIGMA-PGC研究
summary_zh: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素基础的形态学元分析。研究发现，PTSD患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的杏仁核和海马体等区域的灰质（GM）和白质（WM）体积较小。通过对36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像扫描数据进行标准化处理，分析了PTSD患者（n=1309）与对照组（n=2198）之间的体素差异。结果显示，PTSD患者在额叶、颞叶及小脑的GM体积显著减小，尤其是左侧小脑（Hedges' g = 0.22, p校正 = .001），同时小脑的WM体积也较小（峰值Hedges' g = 0.14, p校正 = .008）。这些结构异常可能与创伤暴露相关，提示其在PTSD患者中的特异性。
l1_lead: 研究发现创伤后应激障碍患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的脑区灰质和白质体积显著减小，提示这些结构异常与创伤暴露密切相关。
l2_summary: 本研究针对创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）患者的脑结构异常进行了全脑体素（voxel）基础的形态学元分析，旨在揭示PTSD患者在脑部结构上的特征性变化。研究通过对36个队列的T1加权结构神经影像扫描数据进行标准化处理，比较了PTSD患者（n=1309）与对照组（n=2198）之间的体素差异。结果显示，PTSD患者在与恐惧和记忆处理相关的杏仁核和海马体等区域的灰质（GM）和白质（WM）体积显著减小，尤其是在额叶、颞叶及小脑等区域的GM体积表现出明显的减少，左侧小脑的GM体积减小程度达到Hedges' g = 0.22，经过校正后p值为0.001。同时，小脑的WM体积也较小，峰值Hedges' g为0.14，校正后的p值为0.008。这些结构异常可能与创伤暴露密切相关，提示其在PTSD患者中的特异性。研究结果为理解PTSD的神经生物学基础提供了重要的形态学证据，强调了脑部结构变化在创伤后应激障碍中的潜在作用。

title: Comparison between accelerated and standard or sham rTMS in the treatment of depression: A systematic review.
body: Major depressive disorder (MDD) represents a major global health challenge, with a significant proportion of patients being resistant to drug treatment (TRD). Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has shown promise in the treatment of MDD/TRD, with a single stimulation session per day for five days per week over several weeks (the "standard" protocol). The two main paradigms used are high-frequency rTMS and intermittent theta burst stimulation (iTBS) delivered to the left dorsolateral prefrontal cortex (DLPFC). Accelerated TMS (aTMS) protocols aim to make the treatment more effective, or at least more rapidly effective, by delivering more stimulations in a shorter time, which could also facilitate the implementation of the protocols for a larger number of patients. In this systematic literature review, articles comparing in the same study an aTMS protocol to a standard or sham rTMS protocol were retained for analysis. Thus, 23 articles were retained and the analysis focused on the efficacy of aTMS protocols used for the treatment of depression (MDD/TRD) as well as on the impact of various stimulation parameters, such as stimulation pattern, intersession interval, dosage, and methods of cortical targeting. Although some studies did not report significant differences between aTMS and standard or sham protocols, others suggested potential advantages of aTMS, such as twice-daily HF-rTMS of the left DLPFC or more intensive iTBS protocols with a long interval between two sessions and personalized cortical targeting. Our results highlight the influence of the number of sessions or pulses per session (dosage), the duration of the interval between sessions, and the precision of target localization (using image-guided neuronavigation) on therapeutic efficacy. However, limitations in sample size, few independent studies replicating the same methodology, and variability in the clinical profile of treated patients, given different definitions of treatment resistance or the presence of comorbidities, hamper definitive conclusions.
authors: Lefaucheur JP, Colzi C, Hollander E, Pampaloni I, Van Ameringen M, Baeken C, Fusar-Poli P, Arango C, Fontenelle LF, Batail JM, Brunoni AR, Nicolini H, Haffen E, Soriano-Mas C, Rodriguez CI, Dell'Osso BM, Vieta E, Sauvage

title_zh: 加速与标准或假刺激rTMS治疗抑郁症的比较
summary_zh: 重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）存在抵抗。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）在MDD/TRD治疗中显示出潜力，通常采用每周五天、每天一次的“标准”方案。主要使用的两种模式为高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），针对左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。加速TMS（aTMS）方案旨在通过在较短时间内提供更多刺激，提高治疗效果或加快效果。本文系统评审了比较aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的研究，最终纳入23篇文章，分析了aTMS在抑郁症（MDD/TRD）治疗中的有效性及刺激参数的影响。尽管部分研究未发现aTMS与标准或假刺激之间的显著差异，但其他研究表明aTMS可能具有潜在优势。
l1_lead: 加速TMS（aTMS）在治疗重度抑郁障碍中显示出潜在优势，尽管部分研究未发现其与标准或假刺激rTMS之间的显著差异。
l2_summary:
重度抑郁障碍（MDD）是全球健康领域面临的重要挑战，部分患者对药物治疗（TRD）存在抵抗，导致治疗效果不佳。重复经颅磁刺激（rTMS）作为一种新兴的治疗手段，在MDD/TRD的治疗中展现出良好的潜力。传统的rTMS治疗通常采用每周五天、每天一次的“标准”方案，主要包括高频rTMS和间歇性θ波刺激（iTBS），针对的是左侧背外侧前额叶皮层（DLPFC）。为了提高治疗效果或加快效果，加速TMS（aTMS）方案应运而生，该方案通过在较短时间内提供更多的刺激，旨在提升治疗的有效性。

本文系统评审了aTMS与标准或假刺激rTMS的比较研究，最终纳入了23篇相关文献，分析了aTMS在抑郁症（MDD/TRD）治疗中的有效性及其刺激参数的影响。尽管部分研究未能发现aTMS与标准或假刺激之间存在显著差异，但也有研究表明，aTMS可能在某些情况下具有潜在的优势。这些研究结果提示，尽管aTMS的效果尚需进一步验证，但其在治疗抑郁症方面的应用前景值得关注。

总的来说，aTMS作为一种新型的治疗方案，可能为重度抑郁障碍患者提供新的治疗选择，尤其是对于那些对传统药物治疗反应不佳的患者。未来的研究需要进一步探讨aTMS的具体机制及其在不同患者群体中的适用性，以期为抑郁症的治疗提供更为有效的解决方案。

title: Global study aims to unpack mental health issues facing university students
body: Many students suffer from mental illness but universities have limited support services.
authors: Dan J. Stein
attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/dan-j-stein-376345（名+姓双命中）
title_zh: 全球研究揭示大学生面临的心理健康问题
summary_zh: 许多大学生受到心理疾病的困扰，但高校提供的支持服务有限。研究表明，心理健康问题在大学生中普遍存在，影响他们的学习和生活质量。尽管有需求，许多大学的心理健康资源不足，无法满足学生的需求。这一现象引发了对大学生心理健康支持系统的关注，呼吁高校加强心理健康服务，以帮助学生更好地应对心理挑战。
l1_lead: 研究显示，大学生普遍面临心理健康问题，现有支持服务不足，亟需高校加强心理健康资源以提升学生的生活和学习质量。
l2_summary: 全球研究显示，许多大学生正面临严重的心理健康问题，然而高校提供的支持服务却相对有限。研究指出，心理健康问题在大学生中普遍存在，显著影响他们的学习和生活质量。尽管学生对心理健康服务的需求日益增加，许多大学的心理健康资源仍然不足，无法满足学生的实际需求。这一现象引发了对大学生心理健康支持系统的广泛关注，专家们呼吁高校应加强心理健康服务，以帮助学生更有效地应对心理挑战。通过改善心理健康支持体系，能够为学生提供必要的帮助，提升他们的整体福祉和学业表现。因此，强化心理健康服务不仅是对学生需求的回应，也是促进教育质量和学生发展的重要举措。
l3_translation:
一个国际研究者联盟正在调查全球本科大学生中常见心理障碍的普遍程度。

他们希望量化有多少学生受到心理健康问题的影响，并进一步了解这些障碍的风险因素和发展轨迹。

通过这些信息，他们将能够记录学生的支持需求。这一点非常重要，因为大学生中的心理疾病已成为全球普遍存在的问题。

例如，在美国进行的一项研究覆盖了26个大学校园，显示学生经历了广泛的心理健康问题。至少有17%的学生患有抑郁症。4.1%有惊恐障碍，7.0%有广泛性焦虑，6.3%有自杀意念。还有15.3%的学生报告了非自杀性自伤行为。

在南非，研究表明多达12%的大学生经历中度到重度的抑郁症状。15%的人报告中度到重度的焦虑症状。一项研究发现，在一大样本的南非学生中，多达24.5%在被访谈的两周内报告了某种形式的自杀意念。

尽管大学生的心理痛苦率很高，但证据表明只有六分之一的学生接受了最低限度的心理健康治疗。

即使在高收入国家，心理健康治疗差距也很显著。大约24%的高收入国家的学生获得了他们所需的护理。在低收入和中等收入国家，这一数字则更加悲惨。研究显示，在低收入和中等收入国家，8%到11%的有心理健康问题的学生接受了心理护理。

大学校园中巨大的心理健康治疗差距引发了关于谁有责任照顾学生心理健康的问题。应该由卫生部门、父母还是大学管理者来负责？

在南非，大多数大学都有由专业人员组成的学生咨询服务，旨在满足前来咨询的学生的心理需求。

但这些服务通常超负荷运转。这迫使管理者限制每位学生可以获得的护理量。因此，许多学生甚至无法获得最低限度的护理来支持他们的持续心理健康。

关于大学应该在多大程度上承担学生心理健康责任的问题尚有争议。大学是学术机构，其主要职能是研究、学习和教学。

但尽管大学并不从事医疗保健业务，它们有责任创造有利于学术成功的最佳条件。这包括促进心理健康。

在南非，缺乏足够可及和负担得起的公共心理健康护理服务，提供心理护理的负担目前——也许是不公平地——落在了大学身上。

为学生提供心理和咨询服务是昂贵的。但不提供心理护理的成本可能更高。面临未治疗心理健康问题的学生面临学业失败和辍学的风险，这对大学和最终的纳税人都有成本。

然而，关于大学生在心理健康护理方面究竟需要什么以及哪些服务对哪些学生有效的数据非常有限。

关注学生心理健康的重要性有几个原因。这个发展阶段通常与心理和社会挑战相关联。

学生必须应对许多潜在棘手的过渡。当大多数人开始上大学时，他们已经进入了年轻成年期。通常，他们正在处理家庭和同伴关系的变化。有些人离开家，进入一个新的社会环境，增加了物质滥用的机会。同时，学业压力和经济担忧也在增加。

应对这些过渡的压力可能导致心理功能不良，并引发心理病理症状。

年轻成年期也是多种严重心理疾病发作的高峰期。这包括精神病、抑郁症、焦虑障碍和物质使用问题。如果不加以治疗，这些障碍可能对他们的发展、动机和成就产生严重影响。可能导致辍学和学业失败。

有许多障碍阻止学生获得心理护理。这包括缺乏对心理健康问题的知识、污名化以及学生咨询中心的长时间等待名单等问题。

另一个问题是，大学的干预措施仍然主要依赖于传统的心理治疗方法。这主要是面对面的谈话疗法（如个别咨询）。这既昂贵又不适合所有学生。德国和荷兰的研究人员开发了一些基于互联网的电子干预措施，可以帮助大学生解决问题。但这些干预措施仍需在南非进行测试。

我们的研究项目名为“关爱大学”，旨在填补这一知识空白。斯坦陵布什大学和开普敦大学的研究人员参与了覆盖美国、比利时、西班牙、法国、爱尔兰、澳大利亚、香港、葡萄牙、墨西哥和南非等11个校园的全球研究努力。

一些国家的初步流行病学数据已经收集完毕。

这些信息将用于帮助开发创新、成本效益高且高效的干预措施，以促进大学校园的韧性并减少心理痛苦。

作为“关爱大学”项目的一部分，世界学生健康调查将启动。它将针对第一年大学生。

title: Cannabis use is associated with increased risk of violence: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
body: Cannabis use is a known risk factor for adverse mental health outcomes, including psychosis, which is frequently associated with aggression. However, the specific impact of cannabis use on the risk of violence remains unclear. This meta-analysis, conducted according to PRISMA guidelines, synthesized evidence from 63 peer-reviewed studies (N = 265,079) identified via MEDLINE, EMBASE, and PsycINFO searches up to November 2024 to clarify the link between cannabis use and violence, either as a perpetrator or as a victim. Random-effects models revealed that cannabis users are at a significantly higher risk of perpetrating violent acts. This association was observed in both psychiatric patients (OR 2.49, 95% CI 1.72-3.61) and the general population (OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.74-2.41), and remained significant across both longitudinal (OR 1.17, 95% CI 1.07-1.28) and cross-sectional (OR 2.37, 95% CI 1.66-3.40) study designs. There was an especially large effect for violence involving a criminal conviction in both general (OR 3.75, 95% CI 2.54-5.53) and psychiatric (OR 4.21, 95% CI 2.86-6.22) populations. Furthermore, cannabis use was significantly associated with an increased risk of becoming a victim of violence (OR 1.49, 95% CI 1.38-1.60), a risk more pronounced in females and mixed-gender cohorts compared to males. This meta-analysis indicates an increased risk of violence, especially that resulting in a criminal conviction, among cannabis users. It also highlights the potential of cannabis use as a target for interventions to decrease violence, and underscores the need for routine assessment of cannabis use among psychiatric patients.
authors: Trotta G, Rodriguez V, Marino P, Gurmesa M, Spinazzola E, Li Z, Alameda L, Di Forti M, Murray R, Vassos E.
title_zh: 大麻使用与暴力风险增加相关：系统评价与荟萃分析
summary_zh: 本研究评估了大麻使用对暴力风险的影响，分析了63项经过同行评审的研究（N = 265,079），以明确大麻使用与暴力（作为施暴者或受害者）之间的关系。结果显示，大麻使用者施暴的风险显著增加，精神病患者的比值比（OR）为2.49（95% CI 1.72-3.61），普通人群为2.05（95% CI 1.74-2.41）。这一关联在纵向研究（OR 1.17，95% CI 1.07-1.28）和横断面研究（OR 2.37，95% CI 1.66-3.40）中均显著。涉及刑事定罪的暴力行为在普通人群（OR 3.75，95% CI 2.54-5.53）和精神病患者（OR 4.21，95% CI 2.86-6.22）中效果尤为显著。此外，大麻使用与成为暴力受害者的风险显著相关（OR 1.49，95% CI 1.38-1.60），女性和混合性别群体的风险更高。此荟萃分析表明，大麻使用与暴力风险增加密切相关。
l1_lead: 大麻使用显著增加施暴和成为暴力受害者的风险，尤其在精神病患者和女性中表现更为明显。
l2_summary: 本研究旨在评估大麻使用对暴力风险的影响，通过分析63项经过同行评审的研究，涉及265,079名参与者，明确了大麻使用与暴力行为（无论是施暴者还是受害者）之间的关系。结果显示，大麻使用者施暴的风险显著增加，精神病患者的比值比（OR）为2.49（95% CI 1.72-3.61），而普通人群的比值比为2.05（95% CI 1.74-2.41）。这一关联在纵向研究中也得到了证实，施暴风险的比值比为1.17（95% CI 1.07-1.28），而在横断面研究中则更为显著，施暴风险的比值比为2.37（95% CI 1.66-3.40）。特别是在涉及刑事定罪的暴力行为中，普通人群的比值比高达3.75（95% CI 2.54-5.53），而精神病患者则为4.21（95% CI 2.86-6.22），显示出大麻使用与暴力行为之间的强关联。此外，研究还发现大麻使用与成为暴力受害者的风险显著相关，整体比值比为1.49（95% CI 1.38-1.60），其中女性和混合性别群体的风险更高。综上所述，此荟萃分析表明，大麻使用与暴力风险增加之间存在密切的关联，提示在公共卫生和政策制定中需重视大麻使用对暴力行为的潜在影响。

title: The rising tide of drug-induced psychosis.
body: Recreational use of psychotogenic drugs has become more common in the last 30 years with consequent increase in drug-induced psychosis; 25-50% of such psychoses progress to schizophrenia within 5 years. Most cases result from abuse of methamphetamine or cannabis. The spread of methamphetamine psychosis has occurred without any liberalisation of laws; it is highly addictive and easy to make in small "kitchen" labs. The increase in cannabis use has been facilitated by a softening of attitudes towards the drug, and in some countries, especially in North America, by legalisation for so-called "medicinal use" and then recreational use. The potency of cannabis has greatly increased, especially in countries that have legalised its use, and the worldwide legal sales of cannabis for 2025 are estimated at $ 65 billion. The consequences are being seen with many reports of increases in the incidence of cannabis-psychosis and schizophrenia. In the 1980s some physicians predicted an epidemic of obesity and diabetes due to changes in diet and life style. Sadly, their predictions were correct. We are now at the beginning of a similar epidemic of drug-induced psychosis. Public education campaigns of the type that decreased tobacco smoking are necessary to avoid psychiatric services being overwhelmed.
journal: Neuropsychiatrie : Klinik, Diagnostik, Therapie und Rehabilitation : Organ der Gesellschaft Osterreichischer Nervenarzte und Psychiater
authors: Murray RM, Paparelli A, Di Forti M, Morrison P.
title_zh: 药物诱发精神病的上升潮流
summary_zh: 在过去30年中，精神药物的娱乐性使用变得更加普遍，导致药物诱发精神病的增加；25-50%的此类精神病在5年内进展为精神分裂症。大多数病例源于甲基苯丙胺（methamphetamine）或大麻（cannabis）的滥用。甲基苯丙胺精神病的传播发生在法律没有放宽的情况下，其高度上瘾且易于在小型“厨房”实验室中制造。大麻使用的增加得益于对该药物态度的软化，以及在一些国家，特别是北美，因所谓的“医疗用途”而合法化，随后又用于娱乐。大麻的效力显著增强，尤其是在合法化使用的国家，预计2025年全球合法大麻销售额将达到650亿美元。结果是，大麻精神病和精神分裂症的发生率报告增加。与1980年代一些医生预测的肥胖和糖尿病流行类似，我们现在正面临药物诱发精神病的类似流行。为了避免精神卫生服务被压垮，必须开展类似于减少烟草吸烟的公共教育活动。
l1_lead: 药物诱发精神病的增加与精神药物的娱乐性使用普及密切相关，尤其是甲基苯丙胺和大麻的滥用，亟需公共教育以应对这一流行趋势。
l2_summary:
在过去30年中，精神药物的娱乐性使用显著增加，导致药物诱发精神病的病例上升。研究显示，25%至50%的药物诱发精神病患者在五年内可能发展为精神分裂症（schizophrenia）。大多数此类病例与甲基苯丙胺（methamphetamine）和大麻（cannabis）的滥用密切相关。尽管法律对甲基苯丙胺的管控并未放宽，但其高度成瘾性和易于在小型“厨房”实验室中制造，使得这种药物的精神病传播依然严重。同时，大麻的使用增加得益于社会对其态度的软化，尤其是在北美一些国家，因所谓的“医疗用途”而实现合法化，随后又被广泛用于娱乐目的。合法化后，大麻的效力显著增强，预计到2025年，全球合法大麻销售额将达到650亿美元。这一趋势导致大麻精神病和精神分裂症的发生率显著上升。

与1980年代一些医生对肥胖和糖尿病流行的预测相似，当前我们正面临药物诱发精神病的类似流行。为了避免精神卫生服务体系被压垮，亟需开展类似于减少烟草吸烟的公共教育活动，以提高公众对药物滥用后果的认识，降低精神病的发生率。通过有效的教育和干预措施，可以减缓这一趋势，保护公众健康。

title: The proportion of people with primary affective disorders presenting to early intervention services: systematic review and meta-analysis.
body: Background People with affective psychotic disorders often face diagnostic delays and presentations are under-recognised at first contact with early intervention services (EIS). Despite their clinical significance, most research and service models for first-episode psychosis (FEP) have focused on non-affective psychoses. Aims We sought to clarify the relative prevalence of affective psychoses in EIS. Method A systematic review and random-effects meta-analysis of observational studies reporting proportion of affective psychotic disorders among individuals presenting to EIS with FEP was conducted. Eligible studies included treated FEP populations diagnosed using DSM/ICD criteria. Searches were conducted in Web of Science, Medline and PsycINFO (inception to July 2025). The primary outcome was pooled proportion of affective psychotic disorders. Heterogeneity was assessed using Q -statistics and I 2 -statistics. Meta-regressions examined potential moderators, including urbanicity, national income level and geographical region. Results Eighty-three studies ( N = 30 946; mean age 24.95 years; 34.78% female) were included. Random-effects pooled proportion was 18.0% (95% CI 15.4-20.6; 95% prediction interval 3.6-39.4%; I 2 = 95.6%). Schizoaffective disorder represented 7.4% ( k = 49; 95% CI 5.8-9.2). Schizophrenia was the most frequent diagnosis, with a pooled proportion of 45.5% ( k = 79; 95% CI 40.3-50.7). Meta-regression analyses identified that affective psychoses were less common in Asia and more common in North America compared with Europe. Higher urbanicity was also associated with increased prevalence. Associations with national income level (NIL) were limited by small subgroup sizes. Conclusions Affective psychotic disorders constitute a meaningful subgroup within EIS. This suggests better screening, targeted treatments and adaptive service models of care.
journal: The British journal of psychiatry : the journal of mental science
authors: Catalán A, Swidzinski S, McCutcheon RA, Aymerich C, Pedruzo B, Knox S, Swidzinska P, Tsaligopoulou A, Short R, Carter B, Ratheesh A, Quattrone D, Fearon P, Fusar-Poli P, Young AH, Murray RM, Jauhar S.
title_zh: 初级情感障碍患者在早期干预服务中的比例：系统评估与荟萃分析
summary_zh: 本研究旨在明确在早期干预服务（EIS）中，初级情感障碍（affective psychoses）患者的相对流行率。通过对观察性研究进行系统评估和随机效应荟萃分析，纳入了83项符合条件的研究（N = 30,946；平均年龄24.95岁；女性占34.78%）。结果显示，情感性精神障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），异质性评估结果为I² = 95.6%。其中，情感性精神分裂症（schizoaffective disorder）占7.4%，而精神分裂症（schizophrenia）为最常见的诊断，合并比例为45.5%。该研究强调了情感性精神障碍在首次发作精神病（FEP）患者中的重要性，提示需要在早期干预服务中加强对此类障碍的识别与关注。
l1_lead: 本研究发现，初级情感障碍在早期干预服务中占18.0%，强调了在首次发作精神病患者中加强对该障碍的识别与关注的重要性。
l2_summary: 本研究旨在探讨初级情感障碍（affective psychoses）患者在早期干预服务（EIS）中的相对流行率。通过对83项符合条件的观察性研究进行系统评估和随机效应荟萃分析，研究共纳入了30,946名参与者，平均年龄为24.95岁，其中女性占34.78%。结果显示，情感性精神障碍的合并比例为18.0%（95% CI 15.4-20.6），异质性评估结果为I² = 95.6%，表明研究间存在较大差异。在具体诊断中，情感性精神分裂症（schizoaffective disorder）的合并比例为7.4%，而精神分裂症（schizophrenia）则是最常见的诊断，其合并比例高达45.5%。这些数据强调了情感性精神障碍在首次发作精神病（FEP）患者中的重要性，提示在早期干预服务中应加强对这类障碍的识别与关注，以便为患者提供更为有效的支持和治疗。研究结果为临床实践提供了重要依据，呼吁相关服务机构在设计干预措施时，考虑到情感性精神障碍的普遍性和复杂性，以提升早期干预的效果。

title: Why Is Clozapine Uniquely Effective in Treatment-Resistant Schizophrenia? A Review and Proposal.
body: A great deal is known about the use, benefits, and side effects of clozapine in treatment-resistant schizophrenia (TRS). However, why clozapine is more effective than other antipsychotics in TRS remains unclear. In this article, we address this question. Patients with TRS show glutamate abnormalities, and clozapine has widespread effects on glutamate. However, these actions have not been proven to be different from those of other antipsychotics. Immune dysfunction is also reported in TRS, and clozapine has anti-inflammatory actions, but these have not been correlated with clinical improvement. Currently, there is a great deal of interest in muscarinic abnormalities in psychosis. Unlike most antipsychotics, clozapine has important effects on muscarinic receptors, particularly M 1 and M 4 , and its major metabolite, N-desmethylclozapine, is a full agonist at M 1 . These effects are likely crucial to clozapine's effectiveness. In addition, clozapine's lower dopamine D 2 receptor occupancy has been postulated to allow gradual resolution of dopamine receptor supersensitivity in the minority of patients with TRS who initially respond to antipsychotics but become resistant following long-term dopamine blockade. However, this hypothesis remains controversial. Clozapine's multireceptor profile enables it to have beneficial actions on the nonpsychotic symptoms common in TRS; its ability to bind to histamine H 1 , serotonin 5-HT 1A , and GABA B (gamma-aminobutyric acid B) receptors offers an explanation for its anxiolytic actions, while effects on 5-HT 1A , 5-HT 2A , and 5-HT 7 receptors likely underlie its antidepressant properties. Clozapine shares these properties with olanzapine and quetiapine, but its affinity for muscarinic receptors may be the mechanism by which it is more effective in TRS.
authors: Murray RM, Egerton A, Gao Y, Grace AA, Howes O, Jauhar S, Leucht S, Chen EYH, MacCabe JH, McCutcheon RA, Natesan S, Taylor D.
title_zh: 氯氮平为何在难治性精神分裂症中独特有效？
summary_zh: 本文探讨了氯氮平在难治性精神分裂症（TRS）中的独特疗效。尽管氯氮平在TRS中的使用、益处及副作用已有大量研究，但其为何优于其他抗精神病药物仍不明确。TRS患者存在谷氨酸异常，而氯氮平对谷氨酸有广泛影响，但这些作用尚未证明与其他抗精神病药物不同。此外，TRS中也报告了免疫功能障碍，氯氮平具有抗炎作用，但与临床改善未相关联。氯氮平对毒蕈碱受体（muscarinic receptors）的重要影响，尤其是M1和M4受体，可能是其有效性的关键。氯氮平较低的多巴胺D2受体占用率被认为有助于缓解部分患者的多巴胺受体超敏感性，但这一假设仍具争议。氯氮平的多受体特性使其对TRS中常见的非精神病症状产生有益作用。
l1_lead: 氯氮平在难治性精神分裂症中独特有效，可能与其对谷氨酸、毒蕈碱受体的影响及多受体特性有关。
l2_summary:
氯氮平（Clozapine）在难治性精神分裂症（TRS）中的独特疗效引起了广泛关注。尽管已有大量研究探讨了氯氮平在TRS中的使用、益处及副作用，但其为何优于其他抗精神病药物的机制仍不明确。TRS患者通常存在谷氨酸（glutamate）异常，而氯氮平对谷氨酸的影响较为广泛，然而这些作用尚未证明与其他抗精神病药物存在显著差异。此外，TRS患者中也报告了免疫功能障碍，氯氮平具有抗炎作用，但这一作用与临床改善并未直接相关联。

氯氮平对毒蕈碱受体（muscarinic receptors）的影响，尤其是M1和M4受体，可能是其有效性的关键所在。研究表明，氯氮平较低的多巴胺D2受体占用率被认为有助于缓解部分患者的多巴胺受体超敏感性，但这一假设仍存在争议。氯氮平的多受体特性使其在TRS患者中对常见的非精神病症状产生有益作用，这可能是其在治疗难治性精神分裂症中独特有效的原因之一。

综上所述，氯氮平在TRS中的疗效可能与其对谷氨酸的广泛影响、对毒蕈碱受体的作用以及较低的多巴胺D2受体占用率有关，尽管这些机制尚需进一步研究以明确其具体作用路径。

title: Domain-specific cognitive function in euthymic bipolar disorder: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
body: Background Euthymic bipolar disorder (BD) is associated with general and domain-specific cognitive impairment, which predicts poor occupational and social functioning. Methods We searched Embase, Medline, and PsycInfo for articles published between database inception and June 2024, examining cognitive domains in euthymic BD. We conducted meta-analysis, meta-regressions, including premorbid IQ, demographic, and clinical variables. Newcastle Ottawa Scale, I 2 statistic, and funnel plots/Egger's and Begg's Test were used to assess quality, heterogeneity, and publication bias, respectively. The Benjamini-Hochberg (BH) procedure was utilised for multiple comparisons. Results We identified 95 groups from 75 studies ( N = 4,404 BD & 4,037 HC). BD showed significant impairment in general cognitive functioning (Hedge's g = -0.58, 95%CI: -0.79, -0.37, p g = -0.70, 95%CI: -0.79, -0.60, p g = -0.69, 95%CI: -0.78, -0.60, p g = -0.68, 95%CI: -0.83, -0.53, p g = -0.64, 95%CI: -0.75, -0.54, p g = -0.61, 95%CI: -0.74, -0.49, p g = -0.24, 95%CI: -0.36, -0.12, p β = .066, adjusted p Conclusions Our findings highlight cognitive domains impaired in euthymic BD, indicating targets for interventions. Substantial variance is unexplained, warranting focus on larger samples of individual-level data.
authors: Swidzinski S, Tsapekos D, Swidzinska P, Zhang W, Zheng M, Millgate E, Strawbridge R, Short R, Carter B, Gallagher P, Zanelli J, Kravariti E, Reichenberg A, Young AH, Murray RM, Jauhar S.
title_zh: 躁郁症稳定期的特定领域认知功能：系统评价与荟萃分析
summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了躁郁症（BD）稳定期患者的认知功能，发现其在一般和特定领域均存在显著认知障碍，这与职业和社会功能不佳相关。通过对Embase、Medline和PsycInfo数据库中自创立至2024年6月的文献进行检索，共纳入75项研究，涉及4404名BD患者和4037名健康对照（HC）。荟萃分析结果显示，BD患者在一般认知功能（Hedge's g = -0.58）及多个特定认知领域（如注意力、执行功能等）均表现出显著的功能损害。研究还指出，尽管发现了认知领域的损害，但仍有大量方差未被解释，建议未来研究应关注更大样本的个体数据，以便更深入理解躁郁症对认知功能的影响。
l1_lead: 躁郁症稳定期患者在一般和特定认知领域均存在显著障碍，这与其职业和社会功能不佳相关，未来研究需关注更大样本的个体数据。
l2_summary: 本研究系统评估了躁郁症（Bipolar Disorder, BD）稳定期患者的认知功能，发现这些患者在一般认知功能及特定领域均存在显著的认知障碍，这与其职业和社会功能不佳密切相关。研究通过对Embase、Medline和PsycInfo数据库中自创立至2024年6月的文献进行检索，共纳入75项研究，涉及4404名BD患者和4037名健康对照（Healthy Controls, HC）。荟萃分析结果显示，BD患者在一般认知功能方面的效应量为Hedge's g = -0.58，表明其认知功能显著低于健康对照。此外，研究还发现BD患者在多个特定认知领域，如注意力和执行功能等方面，均表现出明显的功能损害。这些结果提示，尽管已识别出认知领域的损害，但仍有大量方差未被解释，表明未来的研究应关注更大样本的个体数据，以便更深入理解躁郁症对认知功能的影响。总的来说，本研究强调了躁郁症患者在稳定期的认知功能障碍及其对日常生活的潜在影响，呼吁进一步的研究以揭示其背后的机制。

title: Prevalence and associations of fatigue in psychosis: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
body: Background There is increasing interest in fatigue in people with psychotic illnesses. This systematic review and meta-analysis reviewed the evidence concerning the prevalence of fatigue and associated factors in adults with psychotic illnesses. Methods Embase, PsycINFO, Medline and CINAHL were systematically searched for articles in English published between January 1946 to 9 October 2023. Inclusion criteria was 'fatigue' in adults (≥18 years old) with a confirmed ICD11 or DSM5 diagnosis of a psychotic disorder. Risk of bias was assessed with the JBI and the Newcastle-Ottawa Scale. Pooled proportions for fatigue with 95 % CI were calculated using random effects models. Heterogeneity was assessed using Cochran's Q and I 2 statistic and Egger's tests were conducted for publication bias. Results A total of 57 articles met the inclusion criteria and 7 articles (n = 1161 participants) were included for the meta-analysis of fatigue. Fatigue prevalence was 55 % (95 % CI: 37-71 %, I 2 = 94 %). A sensitivity analysis of the 6 studies using a valid scale (n = 711 participants) found a fatigue proportion of 59 % (95 % CI: 41-76, I 2 = 93 %). Eighteen studies (n = 4569 participants) were included for an analysis exploring the prevalence of antipsychotic-related fatigue, which was 20.5 % (95 % CI: 11-34 %). We found no significant difference in antipsychotic-related fatigue between studies using a valid scale (27 %, 95 % CI: 14-46, k = 7) and studies using a clinical interview (17 %, 95 % CI: 7-35 %, k = 11) p = 0.302. An Egger's test indicated no publication bias. Quality assessments for included studies revealed that 16 % were at low risk of bias, 9 % at high risk and 75 % at moderate risk. Reported associations with fatigue included sex, age, antipsychotics, distress and depression, sleep, and some negative symptoms. Conclusions Our study revealed that a majority of people with psychosis experience fatigue. Antipsychotics, sex, and functioning may contribute to tiredness symptoms, but further research is needed.
authors: Poole-Wright K, Patel A, Gaughran F, Murray R, Chalder T.
title_zh: 精神病患者疲劳的流行率及其相关因素的系统评估
summary_zh: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨精神病患者中疲劳的流行率及其相关因素。通过对1946年1月至2023年10月9日间发表的英文文献进行系统检索，共纳入57篇符合条件的文章，其中7篇（1161名参与者）用于疲劳的荟萃分析。结果显示，疲劳的流行率为55%（95% CI: 37-71%，I² = 94%）。在使用有效量表的6项研究中（711名参与者），疲劳比例为59%（95% CI: 41-76，I² = 93%）。此外，18项研究（4569名参与者）分析了抗精神病药物相关的疲劳，流行率为20.5%（95% CI: 11-34%）。研究未发现抗精神病药物相关疲劳在不同研究间存在显著差异。
l1_lead: 精神病患者中疲劳的流行率高达55%，且与抗精神病药物使用相关的疲劳流行率为20.5%。
l2_summary: 本系统评价和荟萃分析旨在探讨精神病患者中疲劳的流行率及其相关因素。研究通过对1946年1月至2023年10月9日间发表的英文文献进行系统检索，最终纳入了57篇符合条件的文章，其中7篇（1161名参与者）用于疲劳的荟萃分析。结果显示，精神病患者中疲劳的流行率为55%（95% CI: 37-71%，I² = 94%），表明在这一人群中，疲劳现象相当普遍。在使用有效量表的6项研究中（711名参与者），疲劳的比例进一步上升至59%（95% CI: 41-76，I² = 93%），显示出疲劳的严重性和普遍性。此外，18项研究（4569名参与者）专门分析了抗精神病药物（antipsychotic medication）相关的疲劳，结果显示其流行率为20.5%（95% CI: 11-34%）。值得注意的是，研究未发现抗精神病药物相关疲劳在不同研究间存在显著差异。这些结果强调了精神病患者中疲劳问题的普遍性及其可能与治疗相关的复杂性，提示临床工作者在治疗精神病患者时需关注疲劳的管理，以改善患者的整体生活质量。

title: Escaping The Bunker: Bobby Gillespie On Primal Scream’s Most Uncompromising Era - clashmusic.com
body:
原话：“I think people like myself have been in opposition all our lives.” / “We just followed our hearts. We weren’t in competition with any other band.” / “I’m trying to write the newest Primal Scream song.”
论点：他认为Primal Scream的音乐是对当时英国音乐的反叛，强调追随内心而非竞争。
论据：他提到自己和乐队在创作时不受传统束缚，追求独特的音乐表达。
authors: Robin Murray
attribution_basis: 作者署名匹配（clashmusic.com） + 论点方向独立复核
quotes: I think people like myself have been in opposition all our lives.
We just followed our hearts. We weren’t in competition with any other band.
I’m trying to write the newest Primal Scream song.
topic_zh: 音乐创作与反叛精神
claim_zh: 他认为Primal Scream的音乐是对当时英国音乐的反叛，强调追随内心而非竞争。
evidence_zh: 他提到自己和乐队在创作时不受传统束缚，追求独特的音乐表达。
article_body:
Bobby Gillespie is a raconteur. A true punk, the Glasgow-born frontman has led Primal Scream through multiple iterations and evolutions, refusing to be hemmed in by expectations. For some fans, their peak came as the debauchery of the 90s collapsed into the paranoia of the Millennium, with a triptych of albums – ‘Vanishing Point’, ‘XTRMNTR’ and ‘Evil Heat’ – presenting the group at their most sonically and politically uncompromising.
Now, he’s taking a rare glimpse back. Spruced up for a lavish re-issue project and an accompanying nationwide tour, ‘The Bunker Trilogy’ – as band mate Andrew Innes terms this period – remains a bracing, inspired listen, a fusion of post-punk, jazz, club culture electronics, and revolutionary politics.
“The idea was: no rules,” he tells CLASH. “Those albums were all recorded in a particular way. We deconstructed the band after ‘Give Out But Don’t Give Up’ – we lost some members. Robert Young, the guitarist, stepped back, so we began to stop writing songs based around guitar riffs, and started writing songs based around rhythm and atmosphere and texture.”
“Andrew Innes and I would go into the studio five days a week. On ‘Give Out But Don’t Give Up’ we reverted to a traditional band structure, but with The Bunker Trilogy that was cast to the wind.”
The highlights rank not only with the band’s best work, but challenge any other group working in that time period. Songs like ‘Star’ and ‘Kowalski’ took daring musicianship and production into the charts, built from the ground up in their tiny London studio. “I had things I wanted to express that I couldn’t express before because I was too inarticulate with language, and maybe too inarticulate with sound and song structure,” Bobby explains, “but the experience that we gathered, meant that we were in a position where we could actually finally make a statement that we’d always wanted to make.”
“We were able to realise something we’d always dreamed of doing by that point because we had the know-how, the expertise, the knowledge, the confidence, and the attitude.”
It helps that the guest cast contains some of British music’s most potent names. my bloody valentine maestro Kevin Shields joins for ‘XTRMNTR’, while the collapse of Manchester icons The Stone Roses saw bass player Mani join the group for a decade-long stint.
“Mani was a great bassist, a great musician,” the frontman notes. “But he was also this life-affirming, fun-love character. And he was very, very smart. He was a Grammar School boy – he went to the same Grammar School as Anthony Burgess, the guy that wrote A Clockwork Orange.” “Underneath that cheeky chappie Manc persona, Mani was a very smart guy. And we had so much fun, so many laughs… and he never played a bad gig.”
If the Bunker title is slightly tongue in cheek, it also reflects the band’s oppositional stance to British music at the time – the Britpop party was fading, stubbed out cigarettes were floating in glasses of flat champagne, and New Labour was firmly in power. “I think people like myself have been in opposition all our lives,” he says. “It was always this us and them attitude. That’s why we were punks when we were teenagers. We needed punk to articulate that, so we could realise we weren’t alone.”
“Britpop was very conservative music, so Primal Scream were definitely not part of that,” he says. “We just followed our hearts. We weren’t in competition with any other band.”
“We just had a different approach to every other band at the time,” he notes. “They were still writing and recording and producing records in the traditional manner that old rock groups did, but we deconstructed that and took a different approach.”
‘XTRMNTR’ lead single ‘Swastika Eyes’ wasn’t built for Radio 1 plays, as Bobby points out. “Radio stations weren’t going to play that song. We were being uncompromising, but that’s how we felt. It was what we wrote about, and if it’s unpalatable for daytime radio then so be it.”
“I kind of felt that at the end of the 90s you’d seen American bombers taking off from British airfields – because we’re kind of like an occupied country, aren’t we? We’re an aircraft carrier for the United States. The whole thing for me was, I think they’re gearing up for something bigger. This is just a dry run for something bigger.”
“And yes, that’s a dystopian view of the world, but I think it just came from the literature I was reading at the time, which was very paranoid. But I actually think I was on the money!”
That’s not to present this music as overly cerebral polemic – ‘Evil Heat’ in particular has moments of uplifting grace. Take Kate Moss’ angelic turn on a cover of ‘Some Velvet Morning’, for example. “We decided we were a track short,” he recalls, “so me and Andrew thought, let’s do a cover, and Kate can sing i.”
“Andrew wanted ‘Love Hurts’, the version by Gram Parsons and Emmylou Harris. I went for ‘Some Velvet Morning’. It was dissolute supermodel meets dissolute rock singer… but with electronics.”
There’s even a cameo from Led Zeppelin icon Robert Plant , who plays harmonica. “We met him in a pub after finishing the session with Kate Moss,” Bobby recalls. “Me being me, I just went up to him! I just said look, we’ve got this song which is a mixture between Throbbing Gristle and Howlin’ Wolf, do you want to play on it? And he did!”
Looking back doesn’t come easily to Bobby Gillespie. For one, some of the people mentioned aren’t with us any more – Mani passed away last year, for example. “I don’t sit about listening to old Primal Scream songs,” he points out during our chat. “I’m trying to write the newest Primal Scream song.”
“This re-issue gives me the chance to listen back to the albums, the B-sides… and I’ve got to say, I’m very proud of what we did. I think we wrote, produced, and released records with honour.”
“We did what a band is supposed to do: challenge themselves and challenge their audience.”
‘The Bunker trilogy’ is out now. Catch Primal Scream on the road this year.

title_zh: 逃离禁锢：Bobby Gillespie谈Primal Scream的无妥协时代
summary_zh: 本文讨论了Bobby Gillespie对Primal Scream乐队的看法，认为该乐队的音乐是对当时英国音乐的反叛。他强调，乐队成员始终追随内心的声音，而非与其他乐队竞争。Bobby Gillespie提到，在创作过程中，Primal Scream不受传统束缚，追求独特的音乐表达，力求创作出最新的Primal Scream歌曲。这种态度体现了他们对音乐的真诚和对艺术的坚持。
l1_lead: Primal Scream乐队通过追随内心声音和无拘无束的创作态度，展现了对音乐的真诚和对艺术的坚持，成为当时英国音乐的反叛象征。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了Bobby Gillespie对Primal Scream乐队的看法，强调该乐队的音乐是一种对当时英国音乐的反叛。Gillespie指出，Primal Scream的成员始终忠于内心的声音，而不是与其他乐队进行竞争。这种独特的创作理念使得他们在音乐创作过程中不受传统束缚，追求独特的音乐表达，力求创作出最新的Primal Scream歌曲。

Gillespie的观点反映了乐队对音乐的真诚态度和对艺术的坚持。他们的音乐不仅仅是为了迎合市场或流行趋势，而是源于对自我表达的渴望和对音乐本质的探索。这种无妥协的态度使得Primal Scream在音乐界中独树一帜，成为一种文化现象。

通过对Primal Scream的分析，Gillespie强调了艺术创作中的自由与个性的重要性，认为只有在摆脱外界压力和传统束缚的情况下，艺术家才能真正实现自我。这种理念不仅适用于音乐领域，也对其他艺术形式有着深远的影响，鼓励艺术家们勇于追求自己的创作道路，展现真实的自我。总之，Primal Scream的音乐不仅是对当时音乐环境的反叛，更是对艺术创作自由的坚定捍卫。

title: The monologue is like an actor's first handshake with a casting director - WGCU
body:
原话：“I consider a monologue the first handshake that you're giving a director.” / “Based on the monologue, we know whether or not you're versatile, and that's the biggest thing we need in an actor, to be versatile.” / “I want to see them start as them and then I want to see an arc and then I want to see almost a resolution and then an ending.”
论点：独白是演员展示多样性的关键，能够反映出他们的能力和情感范围。
论据：独白展示了演员的能力，而侧面剧本只能反映他们对特定角色的把握。
authors: Robin Murray

topic_zh: 演员试镜中的独白重要性
claim_zh: 独白是演员展示多样性的关键，能够反映出他们的能力和情感范围。

article_body:
Facebook LinkedIn Email Print Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Artistic Director Robin Murray, Cultural Park Theatre Actor reads monologue for casting director at Cultural Park Theatre. Whether auditioning for a comedy, drama or musical, an actor arrives at an audition equipped with a head shot, resume and a couple of monologues. Cultural Park Theatre Executive Director Robin Murray says the monologue plays a crucial role in her decision about whether or not to use an actor in a show she is casting.
“I consider a monologue the first handshake that you're giving a director,” said Murray. “It kind of shows what your abilities are without having somebody to rely on, another castmate to rely on or a set or a prop. And we can see what your range is, if you are able to move your body and your voice along with the words without relying on other things on a set.”
According to Murray, the best monologues don’t just showcase an actor’s talent and versatility, they tell a story with a beginning, middle and end.
“I like to see like the seasons in a monologue when somebody gives it,” Murray added. “I want to see them start as them and then I want to see an arc and then I want to see almost a resolution and then an ending.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Actor, author, director and theatre instructor Gerrie Benzing has just published a new book of monologues for kids. Local actor, director and theatre instructor Gerrie Benzing has just published a new book of monologues. She knows exactly what casting directors such as Murray want.
“Since a monologue is a chance to show a director what you can do. I try to put more than one emotion in any monologue I write, so that there's a bit of an arc in it, so that you can show you can play different emotions,” Benzing said.
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing in the role of Lee in Charles Busch's 'The Tale of the Allergist's Wife.' Benzing’s experiences auditioning for roles, performing in a wide variety of shows and teaching theater to children and teens informs the way she crafts each monologue. But it was happenstance that led her to publish three compilations of the monologues she’s been writing since 2006.
“My monologue started, of course, with my own son, who was performing at the time, and we could not find a monologue anywhere that was different, that was new,” Benzing explained. “So, I wrote him one. And he entered the Young Artist Competition, and he was only 10. And it was a competition that went all the way up to college. And he won the whole thing. And so, everybody said please write me a monologue.”
Since then, actors using her monologues have enjoyed considerable success winning roles and competitions around the globe.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Actors using her monologues have enjoyed considerable success winning roles and competitions around the globe. “I have had a student text me from South Africa. He entered a worldwide monologue competition and he won his category. He's since been cast in all kinds of films,” Benzing noted. “I had a boy who auditioned for a Broadway show and used one of my monologues and he was cast. But my biggest success story was Michael Fatica, who I started teaching in summer camps here at the Cultural Park. And he has become a successful star on Broadway.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing It’s everyday kids having success on a local level that really touches Benzing’s heartstrings. But it’s everyday kids having success on a local level that really touches Benzing’s heartstrings.
“The thing that makes me the most proud are the kids that text me and say, ‘Hey, I won my student talent show.’ ‘I got second place. I almost won.’” Benzing added. “And they are so happy. And the fact that I could give them something that they love to do and that they did well with and they were happy with, I think that's the thing that makes me the most happy.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Gerrie Benzing will sign copies of 'Character Monologues for Kids' following the 7:30 p.m. performance of 'Charlie and the Chocolate Factory' on September 19. Cultural Park Theatre will be hosting a book signing for Benzing’s latest book, “Character Monologues for Kids: Own the Moment,” following the 7 p.m. performance of “Charlie and the Chocolate Factory” on Sept. 19 .
The event marks a milestone in Benzing’s career as an author.
“This is my absolute first one and I’m super excited about it.” Benzing noted.
A Chicago native, Robin Murray caught the acting bug in fourth grade. Now living in Southwest Florida, Murray is the producing artistic director of Cultural Park Theatre.
“Cultural Park Theatre is one of the longest running community theaters in Lee County,” Murray noted. “We are now entering into our 64th season. We produce adult plays, children’s plays, comedies, dramas, rom-cons and musicals as well. And our musicals are usually on the lighter side and include children.”
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre. Actors use sides during an audition at Cultural Park Theatre. Every theater has its own way of announcing auditions.
“At Cultural Park, we put out a call usually on social media and then we will give the breakdown of what each character is and whether or not you need to come in with a 16-bar song, 60 seconds, 90 seconds,” Murray said. “For our regular plays, we will also have the breakdown and we will ask you either to come in with a monologue, be very familiar with the show, and then we will have you read sides.”
The term “sides” refers to excerpts from the script that actors are given to learn for an audition. This excerpt could be an entire scene, or just part of one. Depending on the project, sides can also include more than one section of the script for an actor to learn.
The term dates back to Shakespeare, when actors were only given their lines for rehearsals since scripts had to be written longhand.
Theaters often provide the sides in advance of the audition so that actors can familiarize themselves with the lines prior to arriving.
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre The purpose of a well-chosen monologue is to demonstrate an actor's versatility. While a side will give the casting director a rough idea about how an actor will potentially handle the role they’re auditioning for and fit in with the rest of the cast, sides do not reflect the actor’s overall skill set. That’s the purpose of a well-chosen monologue, Murray said.
“Based on the monologue, we know whether or not you're versatile, and that's the biggest thing we need in an actor, to be versatile,” Murray said. The monologue is going to show us an actor’s range where the sides are going to show us if they can carry a character, the specific character.”
Courtesy of Cultural Park Theatre / Robin Murray, Artistic Director, Cultural Park Theatre To gauge an actor’s versatility, the casting director will often have ask the auditioner to switch from drama to comedy while reading a monologue. To gauge an actor’s versatility, the casting director will often have ask the auditioner to switch up the tenor of the reading.
“If you are saying a line that’s very comedic, the director might ask you to read it in a more serious tone,” Murray pointed out.
While monologues are important in all genres, Murray noted that for musical auditions, “the voice is weighted the most because, depending on the part the person is auditioning for, if they cannot hit the note ….”
In addition to directing, Murray is an accomplished actor. Her stage credits include the evil nurse Pat Jones in “Four Old Broads” for The Belle Theatre and Mary Jane McMann in “Inspecting Carol.” She also appeared in “Marvin’s Room,” “I Remember Mama,” “Anton in Show Business,” “The Last Days of Judas Iscariot,” “Picasso at the Lapin Agile,” “On Golden Pond,” “Five Kinds of Silence” and “Calendar Girls.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Benzing played the part of Ruth in the Naples Players' production of 'Calendar Girls' in 2021. About Gerrie Benzing
As the creative director of Monologues4kids.com, Gerrie Benzing has written numerous children’s plays and over 500 monologues for clients worldwide. Dozens of children have used Benzing’s monologues to win movie roles, theater auditions, talent shows and pageants and to secure professional representation.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing Gerrie Benzing's new book 'Character Monologues for Kids.' Her new book is “Character Monologues for Kids: Own the Moment.”
“I have a lot of monologues,” noted Benzing, who has been writing monologues for more than 20 years. “A lot of them are straight comedic monologues, but many are character monologues as well, like Goldilocks talking about how she's not a criminal. When I directed kid shows, I loved seeing characters in the monologue selection. So that's what this [latest book] is, a book of character monologues.”
She included nearly 100 for “Character Monologues for Kids.”
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing 'Duet Acting Scenes for Kids' is among Benzing's books of monologues. Her previous books are “Duet Acting Scenes for Teens,” “Duet Acting Scenes for Kids,” “Monologues4kids Theater Camp Plays: Broadway Version” and “Commercials for Kids.” She has also contributed original monologues to the book “Active Listening,” by Michael Rost and J.J. Wilson.
Courtesy of Gerrie Benzing / Gerrie Benzing 'Duet Acting Scenes for Teens' is among Benzing's books of monologues. “I have lots more monologues,” Benzing added. “So there are more books coming. Lots of them.”
A local stage and film actor, director and musical theatre instructor, Benzing has directed six mainstage productions at Cultural Park Theater, including “Chicago” (2019), “Sister Act” in 2018 (for which she won a Cultural Park Theatre Best Director Marquee Award), “Boeing, Boeing” in 2016 (for which she won as Cultural Park Theatre Best Director Marquee Award) and “Peter Pan” (for which she garnered a Cultural Park Best Director of a Musical Marquee Award in 2014).
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing as Ethel Thayer in 'On Golden Pond' at Cultural Park Theatre in 2019 She has also appeared in more than a dozen shows at Cultural Park Theatre, including the iconic role of Ethel Thayer in “On Golden Pond,” “Harvey” (for which she won a Cultural Park Theatre Best Actress Marquee Award for her portrayal of Veta), “The Glass Menagerie” (in which she was cast as Amanda), “Dixie Swim Club” (Sharee), Bella Manningham in “Angel Street” (Gaslight) , “Bad Seed” (Christine) and Jack Neary’s “The Porch.”
“We asked Gerrie to do a book signing following Saturday night’s performance of ‘Charlie and the Chocolate Factory’ because she’s been an important staple here at the theater,” Murray noted. “A lot of the kids that are directing shows and working here have worked with Gerrie since they were 5 years old. So, it just is a natural thing to bring her back and have her showcase those monologues that the kids use to start their careers.”
WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall / WGCU Arts Reporter Tom Hall Gerrie Benzing as Frau Blucher in The Belle Theatre's 2025 production of 'Young Frankenstein.' Benzing’s other stage credits include Frau Blucher in “Young Frankenstein” at The Belle Theatre, a Pigeon sister in “The Odd Couple” at Fort Myers Theatre, swing for Mary Meeker in “Unnecessary Farce” at Off Broadway Palm, cigarette-smoking, whiskey-swilling sexpot Elaine Navazio in Neil Simon’s “Last of the Red Hot Lovers” for The Belle Theatre, Julia Budder in “It’s Only a Play” at The Studio Players, Caprice in “A Doublewide, Texas Christmas” at Broadway Palm Dinner Theatre, Mother Superior in “Drinking Habits” (The Belle Theatre), Gertrude in “Save Hamlet” (for Lab Theater), Raven in “Trouble (at the Vista View Mobile Home Estates)” for Florida Rep
title_zh: 独白：演员展示多样性的关键
summary_zh: 本文探讨了独白在演员试镜中的重要性。科学家指出，独白是演员与导演之间的首次接触，能够展示演员的多样性和能力。通过独白，导演可以判断演员是否具备多变的表演能力，这是演员最需要的特质。文章强调，独白不仅展示了演员的情感范围，还能体现他们的表演技巧，而侧面剧本则只能反映演员对特定角色的理解。因此，独白在试镜中起着至关重要的作用，能够帮助导演评估演员的潜力和适应性。
l1_lead: 独白在演员试镜中至关重要，它不仅展示了演员的多样性和情感范围，还能帮助导演评估其表演能力和适应性。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了独白（monologue）在演员试镜中的重要性，强调其在演员与导演之间首次接触时所发挥的关键作用。科学家指出，独白不仅是演员展示自身多样性和表演能力的机会，也是导演评估演员是否具备多变表演能力的重要依据。这种多变性被认为是演员最需要的特质之一。通过独白，演员能够展现出丰富的情感范围和高超的表演技巧，而侧面剧本（side script）则往往只能反映演员对特定角色的理解，无法全面展示其表演潜力。

文章进一步强调，独白在试镜中的重要性体现在其能够帮助导演更全面地评估演员的适应性和潜力。通过独白，导演可以观察到演员在不同情境下的表现，进而判断其是否适合某个角色。这种评估不仅依赖于演员的情感表达，还包括他们对角色的诠释能力和即兴发挥的能力。因此，独白在演员试镜中扮演着至关重要的角色，是导演选择合适演员的重要依据。

总的来说，独白作为一种表演形式，不仅展示了演员的个人魅力和专业素养，还为导演提供了一个全面评估演员能力的平台。这使得独白在试镜过程中不可或缺，成为演员与导演之间沟通和理解的桥梁。

title: Genetic and structural aspects of amyloid diseases.
body: The conversion of proteins into insoluble fibrillar aggregates known as amyloid occurs in a wide variety of diseases, e.g., Alzheimer's disease, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, systemic transthyretin amyloidosis, and multisystem atrophy. There are more than 60 disease-associated amyloid-forming proteins, and amyloid formation can occur sporadically or can be induced or accelerated by genetic mutations. This Review discusses structural mechanisms by which genetic changes promote amyloid formation and thereby influence disease outcomes. By dividing amyloid-forming proteins into six types according to the genetic mutations they carry and analyzing mutation-induced structural changes in amyloid fibrils, a better understanding of inheritance patterns of amyloid diseases (amyloidoses) can be obtained.
authors: Rosenberg GM, Murray KA, Sawaya MR, Jiang YX, Geschwind DH, Eisenberg DS.
title_zh: 淀粉样蛋白疾病的遗传与结构特征
summary_zh: 淀粉样蛋白（amyloid）是指蛋白质转化为不溶性纤维状聚集体的过程，这一过程在多种疾病中发生，如阿尔茨海默病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症、全身性转甲状腺素淀粉样变和多系统萎缩等。目前已知有超过60种与疾病相关的淀粉样形成蛋白，淀粉样形成可以是偶发的，也可以因遗传突变而诱导或加速。本文评述了遗传变化如何通过结构机制促进淀粉样形成，从而影响疾病结果。通过将淀粉样形成蛋白根据其携带的遗传突变分为六类，并分析突变引起的淀粉样纤维结构变化，可以更好地理解淀粉样疾病（淀粉样变）的遗传模式。
l1_lead: 淀粉样蛋白疾病的遗传特征与结构机制密切相关，通过分析遗传突变可揭示其对淀粉样形成及疾病结果的影响。
l2_summary:
淀粉样蛋白（amyloid）是指蛋白质转化为不溶性纤维状聚集体的过程，这一过程与多种疾病密切相关，包括阿尔茨海默病、肌萎缩侧索硬化症、全身性转甲状腺素淀粉样变和多系统萎缩等。目前已知有超过60种与疾病相关的淀粉样形成蛋白，这些蛋白的淀粉样形成可以是偶发的，也可以由于遗传突变而诱导或加速。本文探讨了遗传变化如何通过结构机制促进淀粉样形成，从而影响疾病的结果。

研究表明，遗传突变在淀粉样蛋白的形成过程中起着重要作用。通过将淀粉样形成蛋白根据其携带的遗传突变分为六类，研究者能够更深入地分析突变引起的淀粉样纤维结构变化。这种分类方法不仅有助于理解不同类型的淀粉样蛋白如何影响疾病的发生和发展，还为研究其遗传模式提供了新的视角。通过对这些突变的分析，研究者能够揭示出淀粉样疾病（淀粉样变）的遗传机制，从而为未来的治疗策略提供理论基础。

总的来说，淀粉样蛋白疾病的遗传与结构特征的研究为我们理解这些复杂疾病提供了重要的线索。通过深入分析遗传突变与淀粉样形成之间的关系，科学家们能够更好地把握疾病的发生机制，并为开发针对性的治疗方法奠定基础。

title: Understanding the long-term neurological effects of SARS-CoV-2 infection.
body: Post-COVID-19 condition (PCC), also known as long COVID, is a heterogeneous condition marked by persistent symptoms following acute SARS-CoV-2 infection. As approximately 6% of people who have experienced acute COVID-19 are estimated to develop PCC, the potential population is vast. Many of the key symptoms of PCC reflect involvement of the nervous system, ranging from cognitive impairment ('brain fog'), headaches and fatigue to anxiety and depression. This Review summarizes the spectrum of neurological and psychological symptoms that occur following acute SARS-CoV-2 infection, with a particular focus on the international consensus-based core outcome set for PCC. We also explore the proposed underlying mechanisms, including evidence for immune system dysregulation, microvascular dysfunction and volumetric changes on neuroimaging. In addition, we review ongoing and completed large-scale treatment trials. Growing evidence suggests a bidirectional interaction between symptoms traditionally considered neurobiological in origin, such as cognitive deficits and headache, and those within the purview of psychiatry, such as anxiety and depression. PCC represents an opportunity to better understand the long-term consequences of acute infection and improve management strategies and outcomes, not only for people with the condition but also for those with other post-viral syndromes that affect brain health.
authors: Matthews R, Alam A, Bullmore E, Michael BD.
title_zh: 理解SARS-CoV-2感染的长期神经影响
summary_zh: 后COVID-19状态（PCC），也称为长期COVID，是一种异质性疾病，表现为急性SARS-CoV-2感染后的持续症状。约6%的急性COVID-19患者预计会发展为PCC，潜在影响人群庞大。PCC的主要症状涉及神经系统，包括认知障碍（“脑雾”）、头痛、疲劳、焦虑和抑郁等。本文总结了急性SARS-CoV-2感染后出现的神经和心理症状，特别关注PCC的国际共识核心结果集。我们探讨了潜在机制，包括免疫系统失调、微血管功能障碍和神经影像学的体积变化等证据。此外，我们回顾了正在进行和已完成的大规模治疗试验。越来越多的证据表明，传统上被认为是神经生物学起源的症状（如认知缺陷和头痛）与精神病学范畴内的症状（如焦虑和抑郁）之间存在双向互动。PCC为更好地理解急性感染的长期后果及改善管理策略提供了机会，不仅对患者本身，也对其他后病毒综合症患者具有重要意义。
l1_lead: 急性SARS-CoV-2感染后，约6%的患者可能发展为长期COVID，表现为多种神经和心理症状，提示需关注其长期影响及管理策略。
l2_summary:
后COVID-19状态（Post-COVID Condition, PCC），也称为长期COVID，是一种复杂的疾病，表现为急性SARS-CoV-2感染后持续存在的症状。研究表明，约6%的急性COVID-19患者会发展为PCC，这意味着潜在影响的人群非常庞大。PCC的主要症状涉及神经系统，包括认知障碍（常被称为“脑雾”）、头痛、疲劳、焦虑和抑郁等。本文总结了急性SARS-CoV-2感染后出现的神经和心理症状，并特别关注了PCC的国际共识核心结果集。

在探讨PCC的潜在机制时，研究指出免疫系统失调、微血管功能障碍以及神经影像学的体积变化等因素可能与这些症状的发生密切相关。此外，本文回顾了正在进行和已完成的大规模治疗试验，旨在寻找有效的干预措施。越来越多的证据表明，传统上被认为是神经生物学起源的症状（如认知缺陷和头痛）与精神病学范畴内的症状（如焦虑和抑郁）之间存在双向互动，这一发现为理解PCC的复杂性提供了新的视角。

PCC的研究不仅为更好地理解急性感染的长期后果提供了机会，也为改善管理策略奠定了基础。这不仅对PCC患者本身具有重要意义，也对其他后病毒综合症患者的管理和治疗提供了参考。因此，深入研究PCC的机制和症状，将有助于推动相关领域的科学进展和临床实践。

title: Systematic Review and Mega-Analysis of the Peripheral Blood Transcriptome in Depression Implicates Dysregulation of Lymphoid Cells and Histones.
body: Background Depression has been associated with transcriptomic changes in peripheral blood. However, the contribution of specific immune cell subsets or pathways remains unclear, and findings have been variable across previous studies, which have not tended to account for sample cellular composition. Methods We performed a systematic review of peripheral blood transcriptome studies in depression. For the 5 datasets meeting criteria (total N = 6011), we performed harmonized reprocessing and cell composition-adjusted differential gene and transcript analyses, followed by a bias- and inflation-adjusted weighted z score mega-analysis. We investigated the biological pathways and cell subsets implicated by the results. We also performed a sex-stratified gene network mega-analysis using consensus weighted gene coexpression network analysis (WGCNA). Results Few genes showed robust differential gene expression (DGE) in depression. Depression was reproducibly associated with decreases in replication-dependent histones and with a decrease in oxidative phosphorylation pathways in females only. Cell source analyses implicated lymphoid cells (T cells and natural killer cells) as likely contributors to the depression differential expression signature. WGCNA mega-analysis revealed multiple consensus modules associated with depression, with a PUF60-related module upregulated in both female and male depression in sex-stratified analyses. Two genes predicted to be causally relevant to depression by transcriptome-wide association studies (GPX4 and GYPE) showed significant DGE. Conclusions These results are convergent with immunogenetic evidence implicating lymphoid cell dysregulation in depression, while also highlighting histone alterations as a key molecular signature in depression. They also indicate the importance of large-scale datasets for biomarker discovery in the context of heterogeneous disorders such as depression.
authors: Erady C, Bethlehem R, Bullmore E, Lynall ME.
title_zh: 抑郁症外周血转录组的系统评估与大数据分析
summary_zh: 本研究系统评估了抑郁症患者外周血转录组的变化，分析了特定免疫细胞亚群的贡献。通过对5个符合标准的数据集（总样本量N = 6011）进行统一处理和细胞组成调整的差异基因及转录本分析，发现抑郁症与复制依赖性组蛋白的减少及女性特有的氧化磷酸化途径的降低相关。细胞来源分析表明，淋巴细胞（T细胞和自然杀伤细胞）可能是抑郁症差异表达特征的重要贡献者。此外，使用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）进行的性别分层基因网络大数据分析揭示了多个与抑郁症相关的共识模块，其中PUF60相关模块在女性和男性中均上调。
l1_lead: 本研究揭示抑郁症患者外周血转录组变化与特定免疫细胞亚群及复制依赖性组蛋白减少相关，强调淋巴细胞在抑郁症差异表达中的重要作用。
l2_summary:
本研究对抑郁症患者的外周血转录组进行了系统评估，重点分析了特定免疫细胞亚群在抑郁症发病机制中的贡献。研究整合了五个符合标准的数据集，总样本量达到6011，采用统一处理和细胞组成调整的方法，对差异基因及转录本进行了深入分析。结果显示，抑郁症与复制依赖性组蛋白的减少以及女性特有的氧化磷酸化途径的降低密切相关。

在细胞来源分析中，研究发现淋巴细胞，尤其是T细胞和自然杀伤细胞，可能是抑郁症差异表达特征的重要贡献者。这一发现提示了免疫系统在抑郁症中的潜在作用，可能为未来的治疗策略提供新的思路。此外，研究还利用加权基因共表达网络分析（WGCNA）对基因网络进行了大数据分析，结果揭示了多个与抑郁症相关的共识模块。其中，PUF60相关模块在女性和男性中均表现出上调的趋势，进一步强调了性别在抑郁症发病机制中的重要性。

综上所述，本研究通过对大规模样本的转录组分析，揭示了抑郁症与特定基因表达变化之间的关联，尤其是免疫细胞的作用，为理解抑郁症的生物学基础提供了新的视角，并为未来的研究和治疗提供了重要的参考依据。

title: Global Community Health: What Did the COVID-19 Pandemic Teach Us About Neurologic Surveillance Approaches, and How Should We Be Better Prepared?
body: It is well recognized that many pandemic viruses are associated with neurologic complications, most recently with COVID-19. After the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, neurologic surveillance platforms were implemented to characterize the complications of COVID-19. Surveillance platforms are invaluable in providing timely data, informing clinical practice, and directing future research. Lessons learned from recent neurologic surveillance networks include the importance of global and cross-specialty collaboration. It is critical for future surveillance systems to consider these aspects, as it will also serve to improve representation of low and middle-income countries (LMICs) and communities. Trainees played a critical role in the success of neurologic surveillance networks; as frontline health care workers, they were able to provide timely data collection, and their fresh insights are important for future pandemic surveillance system development. In this article, we review the methods of recent neurologic surveillance networks and discuss their strengths and limitations. We explore the outlook for pandemic surveillance platforms and the crucial role global collaboration plays in ensuring that LMICs are represented. We review the role of trainees in pandemic surveillance networks and discuss how it is vital to encourage their continued involvement to ensure that, as future health care leaders, they are prepared to manage future pandemics effectively.
authors: Matthews R, Ellul MA, McKeever S, Pollack T, Houlihan C, Thakur KT, Hsiang-Yi Chou S, Frontera JA, Saylor DR, Chomba M, Moro E, Ray STJ, Semple MG, Smith CJ, Turner MR, Bullmore E, Carson A, Buchan I, Breen G, Solomon T,
title_zh: 全球公共卫生：COVID-19疫情对神经监测的启示与未来准备
summary_zh: 本文评述了COVID-19疫情对神经监测（neurologic surveillance）方法的影响及其教训。疫情暴发后，实施了神经监测平台，以识别COVID-19的神经并发症。这些监测平台在提供及时数据、指导临床实践和未来研究方面发挥了重要作用。文章强调全球和跨专业合作的重要性，指出未来监测系统需考虑低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的代表性。培训生在神经监测网络中扮演了关键角色，作为一线医护人员，他们能够进行及时的数据收集，且其新鲜视角对未来疫情监测系统的发展至关重要。本文回顾了近期神经监测网络的方法及其优缺点，并探讨了全球合作在确保LMICs代表性方面的关键作用。
l1_lead: COVID-19疫情推动了神经监测平台的发展，强调全球合作与低收入国家代表性的重要性，为未来疫情监测提供了重要启示。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了COVID-19疫情对神经监测（neurologic surveillance）方法的影响及其带来的重要教训。随着疫情的爆发，各国迅速实施了神经监测平台，以识别与COVID-19相关的神经并发症。这些监测平台在提供及时数据、指导临床实践和未来研究方面发挥了至关重要的作用，帮助医务人员更好地理解疫情对神经系统的影响。

文章强调了全球和跨专业合作的重要性，指出未来的监测系统必须考虑低收入和中等收入国家（LMICs）的代表性，以确保这些国家在全球公共卫生应对中的声音和需求得到充分体现。培训生在神经监测网络中扮演了关键角色，作为一线医护人员，他们不仅能够进行及时的数据收集，还能提供新鲜的视角，这对未来疫情监测系统的发展至关重要。

此外，本文回顾了近期神经监测网络的方法及其优缺点，指出现有监测系统在数据收集和分析方面的局限性，同时也强调了全球合作在确保LMICs代表性方面的关键作用。通过这些合作，可以更好地整合资源、分享数据，从而提高对疫情的响应能力和监测效率。总的来说，COVID-19疫情为神经监测领域提供了宝贵的经验教训，未来的监测系统需要在设计和实施中充分考虑不同国家和地区的需求，以实现更全面的公共卫生监测和应对。

title: Monitoring of amyloid related imaging abnormalities: SWI vs T2*-GRE.
body: Amyloid-β-directed monoclonal antibody therapies may lead to amyloid-related imaging abnormalities (ARIA). Clinical trials that formed the basis for the ARIA radiographic severity grading scale adopted by the approved drugs' labels utilized T2* gradient recalled echo (T2*-GRE) images for ARIA-hemorrhagic (ARIA-H) assessment. Little is known about the application of susceptibility-weighted imaging (SWI) to ARIA-H assessment. We exploited comparative studies on the usage of SWI instead of 2D T2*-GRE and simulated the impact of SWI's higher sensitivity on the derived ARIA-H severity distribution for three approved drugs. The simulations indicated that the two sequences are not equivalent when grading ARIA-H severity and that the rate of therapy discontinuation would increase by more than 50% compared to the rates reported in the drugs' prescribing information. This should be taken into consideration whenever SWI is applied for ARIA safety monitoring. Appropriate imaging guidelines are needed to enhance management of amyloid-β-directed antibody therapies.
journal: The journal of prevention of Alzheimer's disease
authors: Sima DM, Phan TV, Franceschi AM, Gibbs WN, Barkhof F, Scheltens P, Salloway S, Cummings J, Van Hecke W, Smeets D.
title_zh: 监测淀粉样蛋白相关影像异常：SWI与T2*-GRE的比较
summary_zh: 淀粉样β（Amyloid-β）单克隆抗体疗法可能导致淀粉样蛋白相关影像异常（ARIA）。临床试验中用于ARIA-出血（ARIA-H）评估的放射学严重程度分级采用了T2*梯度回波（T2*-GRE）影像。关于应用敏感性加权成像（SWI）进行ARIA-H评估的研究较少。我们比较了SWI与2D T2*-GRE的使用，并模拟了SWI更高敏感性对三种已批准药物的ARIA-H严重程度分布的影响。模拟结果表明，这两种序列在评估ARIA-H严重程度时并不等效，且治疗中断率将比药物说明书中报告的提高超过50%。因此，在应用SWI进行ARIA安全监测时需考虑这一点，并需制定适当的影像学指南以改善淀粉样β抗体疗法的管理。
l1_lead: SWI在评估淀粉样蛋白相关影像异常（ARIA-H）时比T2*-GRE更敏感，可能导致治疗中断率显著增加，因此需制定相应影像学指南以优化管理。
l2_summary:
本研究聚焦于淀粉样蛋白相关影像异常（ARIA），特别是ARIA-出血（ARIA-H）的评估，比较了敏感性加权成像（SWI）与T2*梯度回波（T2*-GRE）在这一领域的应用。淀粉样β（Amyloid-β）单克隆抗体疗法可能引发ARIA，而临床试验中通常采用T2*-GRE影像来评估ARIA-H的放射学严重程度。然而，关于SWI在ARIA-H评估中的应用研究相对较少。

通过对SWI与2D T2*-GRE的比较，研究发现这两种影像序列在评估ARIA-H严重程度时并不等效。模拟结果显示，SWI的更高敏感性可能导致对三种已批准药物的ARIA-H严重程度分布的显著影响，具体而言，治疗中断率将比药物说明书中报告的提高超过50%。这一发现提示，在使用SWI进行ARIA的安全监测时，必须充分考虑其敏感性对评估结果的影响。

因此，研究建议在淀粉样β抗体疗法的管理中，需制定适当的影像学指南，以改善对ARIA的监测和管理。这一研究为临床实践提供了重要的参考，强调了影像学评估工具的选择对患者治疗决策的重要性。

title: Systematic attribution of heatwaves to the emissions of carbon majors.
body: Extreme event attribution assesses how climate change affected climate extremes, but typically focuses on single events 1-4 . Furthermore, these attributions rarely quantify the extent to which anthropogenic actors have contributed to these events 5,6 . Here we show that climate change made 213 historical heatwaves reported over 2000-2023 more likely and more intense, to which each of the 180 carbon majors (fossil fuel and cement producers) substantially contributed. This work relies on the expansion of a well-established event-based framework 1 . Owing to global warming since 1850-1900, the median of the heatwaves during 2000-2009 became about 20 times more likely, and about 200 times more likely during 2010-2019. Overall, one-quarter of these events were virtually impossible without climate change. The emissions of the carbon majors contribute to half the increase in heatwave intensity since 1850-1900. Depending on the carbon major, their individual contribution is high enough to enable the occurrence of 16-53 heatwaves that would have been virtually impossible in a preindustrial climate. We, therefore, establish that the influence of climate change on heatwaves has increased, and that all carbon majors, even the smaller ones, contributed substantially to the occurrence of heatwaves. Our results contribute to filling the evidentiary gap to establish accountability of historical climate extremes 7,8 .
authors: Quilcaille Y, Gudmundsson L, Schumacher DL, Gasser T, Heede R, Heri C, Lejeune Q, Nath S, Naveau P, Thiery W, Schleussner CF, Seneviratne SI.
title_zh: 系统归因热浪与碳排放大户的关系
summary_zh: 极端事件归因评估气候变化对气候极端事件的影响，通常集中于单一事件。本文展示了气候变化使2000-2023年间报告的213个历史热浪变得更可能且更强烈，180个碳排放大户（化石燃料和水泥生产商）对此有显著贡献。研究表明，自1850-1900年以来，2000-2009年间热浪的中位数发生概率增加了约20倍，2010-2019年间则增加了约200倍。总体来看，四分之一的热浪事件在没有气候变化的情况下几乎不可能发生。碳排放大户的排放量导致自1850-1900年以来热浪强度增加的一半。根据不同的碳排放大户，其个体贡献足以使16-53个在前工业气候中几乎不可能发生的热浪出现。因此，气候变化对热浪的影响已显著增加，所有碳排放大户，包括较小的企业，都对热浪的发生作出了重要贡献。
l1_lead: 气候变化显著增加了热浪的发生概率和强度，180个碳排放大户对此贡献巨大，导致自1850年以来热浪强度增加了一半。
l2_summary:
本文探讨了气候变化与热浪之间的关系，特别关注了碳排放大户（主要是化石燃料和水泥生产商）对热浪事件的影响。研究显示，自2000年至2023年间，气候变化使得213个历史热浪事件的发生变得更加可能且强烈。具体而言，自1850-1900年以来，2000-2009年间热浪的中位数发生概率增加了约20倍，而在2010-2019年间则进一步增加至约200倍。这一趋势表明，气候变化对热浪的影响显著增强，尤其是在没有气候变化的情况下，四分之一的热浪事件几乎是不可能发生的。

研究还指出，碳排放大户的排放量对热浪强度的增加贡献了约一半的原因。根据不同碳排放大户的个体贡献，足以导致16至53个在前工业气候条件下几乎不可能发生的热浪事件的出现。这一发现强调了所有碳排放大户，包括较小企业，在热浪发生中的重要作用。因此，研究结果不仅揭示了气候变化对热浪事件的深远影响，也明确了碳排放大户在这一过程中所承担的责任。整体来看，气候变化显著提高了热浪的发生频率和强度，呼吁各方关注并采取行动以减缓气候变化带来的影响。

title: Global emergence of unprecedented lifetime exposure to climate extremes.
body: Climate extremes are escalating under anthropogenic climate change 1 . Yet, how this translates into unprecedented cumulative extreme event exposure in a person's lifetime remains unclear. Here we use climate models, impact models and demographic data to project the number of people experiencing cumulative lifetime exposure to climate extremes above the 99.99th percentile of exposure expected in a pre-industrial climate. We project that the birth cohort fraction facing this unprecedented lifetime exposure to heatwaves, crop failures, river floods, droughts, wildfires and tropical cyclones will at least double from 1960 to 2020 under current mitigation policies aligned with a global warming pathway reaching 2.7 °C above pre-industrial temperatures by 2100. Under a 1.5 °C pathway, 52% of people born in 2020 will experience unprecedented lifetime exposure to heatwaves. If global warming reaches 3.5 °C by 2100, this fraction rises to 92% for heatwaves, 29% for crop failures and 14% for river floods. The chance of facing unprecedented lifetime exposure to heatwaves is substantially larger among population groups characterized by high socioeconomic vulnerabilities. Our results call for deep and sustained greenhouse gas emissions reductions to lower the burden of climate change on current young generations.
authors: Grant L, Vanderkelen I, Gudmundsson L, Fischer E, Seneviratne SI, Thiery W.
title_zh: 气候极端事件对人类终生影响的全球性新现象
summary_zh: 随着人类活动引发的气候变化，气候极端事件正在加剧。本文利用气候模型、影响模型和人口数据，预测在2100年之前，经历终生气候极端事件（如热浪、农作物失败、河流洪水、干旱、野火和热带气旋）的人口比例将显著增加。预计在当前减缓政策下，从1960年到2020年，面临这种前所未有的终生暴露的出生队列比例将至少翻倍。在1.5°C的全球变暖路径下，2020年出生的52%的人将经历前所未有的热浪暴露；若全球变暖达到3.5°C，热浪的比例将上升至92%。高社会经济脆弱性的人群面临这种终生暴露的风险显著更高。研究结果强调了需要大幅度和持续减少温室气体排放，以减轻气候变化对当前年轻一代的影响。
l1_lead: 气候变化导致的极端事件将使未来出生的人口面临显著增加的终生暴露风险，尤其是高社会经济脆弱性群体，亟需采取减排措施。
l2_summary: 随着人类活动导致的气候变化加剧，气候极端事件的发生频率和强度也在不断上升。最新研究利用气候模型、影响模型和人口数据，预测到2100年，经历终生气候极端事件（如热浪、农作物失败、河流洪水、干旱、野火和热带气旋）的人口比例将显著增加。根据当前的减缓政策，从1960年到2020年，面临这种前所未有的终生暴露的出生队列比例预计将至少翻倍。在1.5°C的全球变暖路径下，2020年出生的52%的人将经历前所未有的热浪暴露；而如果全球变暖达到3.5°C，这一比例将上升至92%。此外，研究还发现，高社会经济脆弱性的人群面临这种终生暴露的风险显著更高。这些结果强调了迫切需要大幅度和持续减少温室气体排放，以减轻气候变化对当前年轻一代的影响。研究表明，气候极端事件不仅是短期的自然灾害，更是对未来世代的长期威胁，尤其是对那些社会经济条件较差的群体。因此，采取有效的气候政策和减排措施已成为当务之急，以保护未来的人类生活环境。

title: NCCR CLIM+: Kick-off for a more climate-resilient Switzerland - usys.ethz.ch
body:
原话：“Our vision is to investigate the main challenges Switzerland faces with increasing global warming and to help develop solutions for both climate change mitigation and adaptation.” / “This is only possible together with society.”
论点：瑞士面临全球变暖带来的主要挑战，需要与社会共同开发气候变化的缓解和适应解决方案。
authors: Sonia I. Seneviratne

quotes: Our vision is to investigate the main challenges Switzerland faces with increasing global warming and to help develop solutions for both climate change mitigation and adaptation.
This is only possible together with society.
topic_zh: 应对气候变化的挑战与解决方案
claim_zh: 瑞士面临全球变暖带来的主要挑战，需要与社会共同开发气候变化的缓解和适应解决方案。
article_body:
Department of Environmental Systems Science Services Student portal Alumni association Staffnet Login Search Search en EN DE Departments ETH Zurich D-USYS Language Selection en English Deutsch You are here Homepage News & Events News Archive 2026 09 NCCR CLIM+: Kick-off for a more climate-resilient Switzerland NCCR CLIM+: Kick-off for a more climate-resilient Switzerland With the official launch of the National Centre of Competence in Research (NCCR) CLIM+, researchers, public authorities, businesses and organisations are joining forces to strengthen Switzerland's resilience to climate extremes. Co-led by ETH Zurich and the University of Bern, the NCCR combines climate research with practical solutions for society, the economy and policymaking.
The National Centre of Competence in Research (NCCR) is jointly directed by Prof. Sonia I. Seneviratne (ETH Zurich) and Prof. Karin Ingold (University of Bern), with Prof. David N. Bresch and Prof. Olivia Romppainen-Martius serving as deputy co-directors. CLIM+ brings together 47 research groups from 13 Swiss institutions and works closely with public authorities, businesses and civil society organisations. "Our vision is to investigate the main challenges Switzerland faces with increasing global warming and to help develop solutions for both climate change mitigation and adaptation," says Sonia Seneviratne. "This is only possible together with society."
A key element of the programme is the development of climate storylines: interdisciplinary narratives that combine scientific knowledge and societal perspectives to explore how extreme events could unfold and how risks can be managed.
CLIM+ strengthens a research area of growing societal importance. The programme combines climate science, risk modelling and decision analysis to support informed decision-making and long-term resilience. "CLIM+ shifts the approach from reacting to isolated extremes to systematically preparing for plausible future risks," explains David N. Bresch.
At the kick-off event, representatives from science, government and practice highlighted the importance of translating research into action, from climate-resilient infrastructure and water management to governance and emergency preparedness. Speakers also stressed that adaptation alone is not enough and must be accompanied by ambitious climate mitigation efforts.
Looking ahead, CLIM+ aims to create lasting bridges between research, policy and society while contributing knowledge that supports Switzerland's climate-risk strategies and strengthens dialogue between science and the public.
The external page NCCR CLIM+ (Climate Extremes and Society: Strengthening Resilience) receives CHF 16.88 million in federal funding and additional support from ETH Zurich and the University of Bern. Researchers from D-USYS involved in the programme include Nicolas Gruber, Andreas Prein, Erich Fischer, Manuela Brunner, Reto Knutti, Tina Schnadt Poberaj, Lukas Gudmundsson and Ulrike Lohmann. external page Kick-off for a more climate-resilient Switzerland , Article from Uni Bern, 15.09.2026

title_zh: NCCR CLIM+: 启动更具气候韧性的瑞士
summary_zh: NCCR CLIM+项目旨在研究瑞士在全球变暖加剧背景下面临的主要挑战，并与社会共同开发应对气候变化的缓解（mitigation）和适应（adaptation）解决方案。项目强调，只有通过社会的共同努力，才能有效应对气候变化带来的影响。
l1_lead: NCCR CLIM+项目强调，瑞士应对气候变化的挑战需要社会共同努力，开发有效的缓解和适应解决方案。
l2_summary:
NCCR CLIM+项目旨在深入研究瑞士在全球变暖加剧背景下面临的主要挑战，并与社会各界共同开发应对气候变化的缓解（mitigation）和适应（adaptation）解决方案。该项目强调，面对气候变化带来的影响，单靠科学界或政府的努力是远远不够的，必须依靠社会的共同努力，才能有效应对这一全球性问题。通过与社会各界的合作，NCCR CLIM+项目希望能够整合不同领域的知识与资源，推动瑞士在气候韧性方面的提升。

在研究过程中，NCCR CLIM+项目将聚焦于气候变化对瑞士的具体影响，包括生态系统、经济和社会结构等多个方面。项目团队将通过数据收集和分析，识别出瑞士在气候变化背景下的脆弱环节，并提出相应的解决方案。这些解决方案不仅包括技术层面的创新，还涉及政策制定、公众参与和教育等多方面的综合措施，以确保应对气候变化的策略能够被广泛接受和有效实施。

项目的核心论点是，气候变化的影响是复杂且多维的，只有通过跨学科的合作与社会的广泛参与，才能找到切实可行的应对之道。NCCR CLIM+项目的成功实施，将为瑞士在应对气候变化的过程中提供重要的理论支持和实践指导，助力瑞士在全球气候治理中发挥更为积极的作用。通过这一项目，瑞士不仅能够提升自身的气候韧性，还能为其他国家提供宝贵的经验和借鉴，推动全球范围内的气候行动。

title: The chemistry of habitable oceans in the Solar system.
body: Liquid water exists on the Earth and several other planetary bodies in our solar system. The chemical character of these aqueous reservoirs is central to evaluating their habitability. Here, we synthesize the chemical features of water reservoirs and their biological implications on the modern Earth. We then outline constraints on the evolutionary history of Earth's ocean chemistry and discuss its interplay with the biosphere. Furthermore, we examine the inferred chemical environments of water bodies on early Mars, dwarf planet Ceres, Jupiter's moon Europa and Saturn's moons Enceladus and Titan. We conclude by outlining priority questions for future planetary habitability studies.
authors: Hao J, Zhu Y, Knoll AH, Tosca NJ, He C, Vetter MCYL, Liao L, Crockford PW, Stüeken EE, Huo A, Li J, Mondal JA, Catling DC, Song Y, Ju P, Pan L, Huang F, Glein CR.
title_zh: 太阳系可居住海洋的化学特征
summary_zh: 液态水存在于地球及我们太阳系的多个天体上，这些水体的化学特性对于评估其可居住性至关重要。本文综合了现代地球水体的化学特征及其生物学影响，概述了地球海洋化学的演化历史及其与生物圈的相互作用。此外，我们还考察了早期火星、矮行星谷神星、木星的卫星欧罗巴以及土星的卫星恩克拉多斯和泰坦的水体化学环境。最后，我们提出了未来行星科学研究的优先问题。
l1_lead: 液态水的化学特性在评估太阳系各天体的可居住性中至关重要，本文探讨了地球及其他天体水体的化学演化及其与生命的关系。
l2_summary:
液态水的存在是地球及太阳系内多个天体可居住性的关键因素，而这些水体的化学特征对于评估其生物适宜性至关重要。本文综合了现代地球水体的化学特征及其对生物的影响，探讨了地球海洋化学的演化历史以及其与生物圈的相互作用。研究表明，地球的海洋化学环境经历了复杂的演变过程，这一过程不仅影响了地球的气候和地质活动，还为生命的起源和发展提供了必要的条件。

此外，本文还考察了其他天体的水体化学环境，包括早期火星、矮行星谷神星（Ceres）、木星的卫星欧罗巴（Europa）以及土星的卫星恩克拉多斯（Enceladus）和泰坦（Titan）。这些天体的水体化学特征各具特色，早期火星可能曾拥有适宜生命存在的液态水环境，而谷神星的盐水可能为微生物提供了生存的机会。欧罗巴的冰壳下可能隐藏着液态海洋，其化学成分的复杂性使其成为寻找外星生命的重点目标。恩克拉多斯则以其喷发的水蒸气和有机物质而引起关注，显示出其潜在的生物适宜性。泰坦的液态甲烷和乙烷湖泊则提供了与地球截然不同的化学环境，尽管与地球生命形式不同，但仍然引发了对生命可能性的思考。

最后，本文提出了未来行星科学研究的优先问题，强调了对这些天体水体化学特征的深入研究对于理解生命起源和分布的重要性。通过对比不同天体的水体化学环境，我们可以更好地评估它们的可居住性，并为未来的探索任务提供科学依据。

title: Green finance? Why global banks are pledging billions to fight climate change
body: Announcing green finance packages is one way of deflecting criticism for fossil fuel investments.
authors: Simon A. Wilde
attribution_basis: The Conversation 作者页 /profiles/simon-wilde-422290（名+姓双命中）
title_zh: 全球银行为何承诺数十亿抗击气候变化
summary_zh: 本文探讨了全球银行在应对气候变化方面承诺数十亿资金的现象，指出这是一种转移对化石燃料投资批评的策略。通过推出绿色金融（green finance）方案，银行试图改善其公众形象，减轻因投资于化石燃料而受到的负面评价。文章分析了这一现象的背后动机及其对气候行动的实际影响，强调了银行在推动可持续发展方面的责任与挑战。
l1_lead: 全球银行承诺数十亿抗击气候变化，实为转移对化石燃料投资批评的策略，旨在改善形象并应对可持续发展挑战。
l2_summary:
全球银行在应对气候变化方面承诺数十亿资金的现象引发了广泛关注。本文探讨了这一现象的背后动机，指出银行通过推出绿色金融（green finance）方案，试图改善其公众形象，并减轻因投资于化石燃料而受到的负面评价。这种承诺不仅是对外界批评的回应，也是一种策略性转移，旨在展示其在可持续发展方面的努力。

银行的这一举措反映了其在气候行动中的责任与挑战。尽管承诺的资金数额庞大，但文章分析认为，这些承诺是否能真正推动气候行动仍需观察。许多银行在承诺绿色金融的同时，仍然在化石燃料领域进行大量投资，这使得其真正的环保意图受到质疑。通过对比银行的投资组合，文章指出，尽管绿色金融项目的资金流入有所增加，但整体上，银行对化石燃料的依赖并未显著减少。

此外，文章强调，银行在推动可持续发展方面面临的挑战不仅包括如何平衡短期利润与长期环境责任，还涉及到如何有效地将资金投入到真正有助于减缓气候变化的项目中。银行的承诺如果仅停留在表面，而缺乏实质性的行动和透明度，将难以赢得公众的信任。

综上所述，全球银行在气候变化领域的资金承诺是一种复杂的现象，既反映了其对外界压力的回应，也揭示了其在可持续发展道路上的责任与挑战。未来，银行能否真正实现其绿色金融的承诺，将对全球气候行动产生深远影响。
l3_translation:
全球银行巨头汇丰银行承诺投入1000亿美元（约合760亿英镑）用于“应对气候变化”，这笔资金将在未来八年内用于可持续金融和投资。它还承诺增加自身可再生能源的使用，并减少对煤炭项目的融资。

汇丰银行正跟随投资银行日益增长的趋势，其中包括摩根大通2000亿美元的融资承诺、麦格理收购英国绿色投资银行，以及德意志银行、法国农业信贷银行等退出煤炭贷款的举措。

我对这些交易了解颇多，因为我在能源投资银行工作了25年，现在在巴斯大学和帝国理工学院研究该领域。那么，这些举措有多重要，它们可能产生什么影响呢？

毫无疑问，向绿色经济转型需要显著的投资，超出当前水平。经济合作与发展组织（OECD）估计，从2016年到2030年，每年需要额外6000亿美元的基础设施投资，以实现《巴黎协定》的气候目标，涵盖能源、交通和其他领域。

作为这一转型的一部分，绿色能源投资已经在快速增长：联合国报告称，过去十年清洁能源资产融资翻了一番，从2007年到2016年总共筹集了16570亿美元，其中大部分来自银行贷款。因此，汇丰银行和摩根大通在未来十年内的3000亿美元投资，尽管重要，但本身并不会改变游戏规则。然而，这确实反映了我们已经看到的持续增长，这种增长是由可再生能源成本的下降和政府政策的广泛支持所推动的。

银行还在鼓励“绿色债券”市场的增长，在这个市场上，公司和政府专门为环保项目筹集资金，例如新的风电场、太阳能技术或更节能的住房——这些资金是专款专用并受到外部监控的。绿色债券市场仍然较小，占全球年度债券发行量的不到2%。然而，交易量正在快速增长，包括经济合作与发展组织在内的观察者认为，这一市场对气候融资至关重要。汇丰银行和其他银行在绿色债券方面积极参与，发行自己的债券并帮助其他人进入市场。

人们担心，由于监管变化，例如巴塞尔协议III框架，银行贷款可能会随着时间的推移而减少，该框架要求银行降低杠杆率并保持更多的资本储备。因此，各国政府也在鼓励大型机构投资者（如养老金或人寿保险基金）直接进行更多投资。增加对更好结构化的清洁能源项目的股权和债务投资，对政策制定者和金融家来说都是一项挑战。

同样，许多与气候相关的投资在新兴市场或高风险早期创新和开发中是必要的。例如，麻省理工学院去年强调了清洁技术风险投资资金的下降，尽管现有技术的部署获得了更多的贷款和投资。可能是，继续对“安全投资”（例如使用成熟技术的英国风电场）进行整体商业银行贷款，对这些更困难的领域支持不大。

一些人质疑银行的动机：气候变化压力团体“气候变化银行”指出，2014年至2016年，全球最大的银行向煤炭、液化天然气和环境敏感的石油项目贷款2900亿美元，其中摩根大通是第三大贷款方，汇丰银行排名第八。宣布绿色金融方案是转移对这些活动批评的一种方式。

同样，气候变化诉讼的风险正在上升，哥伦比亚法学院指出，自2014年以来气候案件数量增加了三倍。最近针对澳大利亚联邦银行的诉讼突显了银行被起诉的潜力。在面临已撤回的诉讼时，CBA承认气候变化是一个重大风险，首次发布了气候政策，并退出了一个有争议的煤炭项目。汇丰银行本周宣布的举措，可以被视为避免类似问题的背景。

话虽如此，汇丰银行和其他银行可能确实是在响应自身——尤其是年轻——客户对可持续产品日益增长的需求。所有成功的组织都需要适应客户偏好的变化，任何代际间的环境观念转变都要求银行——像其他公司一样——调整其营销策略。

那么，我们应该如何总结这些举措呢？

商业银行增加绿色贷款，虽然不是全部答案，但值得欢迎。继续为日益低成本的可再生能源的增长部署提供融资，对气候变化行动产生积极贡献。面对对贷款者潜在负面贡献（例如在煤炭行业）的日益审查，银行希望能够高调宣传其绿色资质，这也是可以理解的。

更多的努力是必要的——来自政府、发展机构、长期投资者和银行的努力——但汇丰银行和其他银行最近的举措是向前迈出的一步。从2020年回顾，看看实际投入可再生能源和更碳密集行业的相对投资水平将会很有趣。

帝国理工学院商学院研究员，巴斯大学博士研究生

Simon Wilde获得经济和社会研究委员会的资助，并在麦格理资本（欧洲）有限公司兼职工作。本文中表达的观点仅代表他本人。
